words.en: to become less intense or widespread
words.example: The storm finally abated toward dawn, and the fishermen returned to the harbor.
words.example_zh: 暴风雨在黎明前终于减弱，渔民们回到了港口。

words.en: departing from an accepted standard or normal type
words.example: Her aberrant behavior at the meeting puzzled colleagues who had known her for years.
words.example_zh: 她在会上的异常举动让认识她多年的同事感到困惑。

words.en: a state of temporary disuse or suspension
words.example: The proposal was held in abeyance until the committee could gather more evidence.
words.example_zh: 该提案被暂时搁置，直到委员会能收集更多证据。

words.en: to leave hurriedly and secretly to avoid capture
words.example: The treasurer absconded with the club funds before anyone noticed the missing money.
words.example_zh: 财务在有人发现资金短缺前带着俱乐部的钱潜逃了。

words.en: difficult to understand because of complexity
words.example: The lecture was so abstruse that even the graduate students left thoroughly confused.
words.example_zh: 那场讲座如此深奥，连研究生们听完都彻底糊涂了。

words.en: an award or expression of praise
words.example: The young architect received accolades from critics who rarely praised anyone so publicly.
words.example_zh: 这位年轻建筑师得到了很少公开赞扬他人的批评家们的赞誉。

words.en: gradual growth by the addition of layers or parts
words.example: The reef grew by slow accretion over thousands of years of coral deposits.
words.example_zh: 这片珊瑚礁经过数千年珊瑚沉积的缓慢积累而形成。

words.en: sharp and forthright in tone or manner
words.example: His acerbic reviews entertained readers but infuriated nearly every playwright in the city.
words.example_zh: 他尖刻的评论取悦了读者，却几乎激怒了城里所有剧作家。

words.en: to accept something reluctantly but without protest
words.example: She acquiesced to the new schedule, though her silence hardly signaled genuine approval.
words.example_zh: 她默许了新的安排，尽管她的沉默几乎不代表真正的赞同。

words.en: angry and bitter in speech or dispute
words.example: The negotiations grew acrimonious once both sides began questioning each other's motives.
words.example_zh: 一旦双方开始质疑彼此的动机，谈判就变得剑拔弩张。

words.en: the ability to make good judgments and quick decisions
words.example: Her business acumen turned a failing bookstore into the neighborhood's most profitable shop.
words.example_zh: 她的商业敏锐使一家倒闭中的书店变成了社区最赚钱的店铺。

words.en: refusing to be persuaded or to change one's mind
words.example: He remained adamant that the experiment be repeated before any results were published.
words.example_zh: 他坚持认为在发表任何结果之前必须重复这个实验。

words.en: to warn or reprimand someone firmly
words.example: The coach admonished his players for celebrating before the final whistle had blown.
words.example_zh: 教练责备球员们在终场哨响之前就开始庆祝。

words.en: clever or skillful in using the hands or mind
words.example: She proved remarkably adroit at defusing arguments that others had made hopelessly personal.
words.example_zh: 她在化解被别人搞得极为针对个人的争论方面显得非常机敏。

words.en: to make something poorer in quality by adding another substance
words.example: Merchants had adulterated the olive oil with cheaper seed oils for nearly a decade.
words.example_zh: 商人们近十年来一直用更便宜的种子油掺入橄榄油。

words.en: to outline or foreshadow something in a vague way
words.example: The opening chapter adumbrates themes the novel develops fully only near its end.
words.example_zh: 开篇章节勾勒出小说直到接近结尾才充分展开的主题。

words.en: happening by chance rather than by design
words.example: The discovery was entirely adventitious, arising from a mislabeled sample in the freezer.
words.example_zh: 这个发现完全出于偶然，源自冷柜里一个贴错标签的样本。

words.en: concerned with beauty or the appreciation of beauty
words.example: Their disagreement was aesthetic rather than practical, concerning color rather than structural safety.
words.example_zh: 他们的分歧是审美上的而非实用上的，关乎颜色而非结构安全。

words.en: friendly, good-natured, and easy to talk to
words.example: The affable host made even the shyest guests feel comfortable within a few minutes.
words.example_zh: 这位和蔼的主人几分钟内就让最害羞的客人也感到自在。

words.en: to increase the power, wealth, or reputation of
words.example: He rewrote the company history largely to aggrandize his own modest role in it.
words.example_zh: 他改写公司史，主要是为了夸大自己在其中并不显赫的作用。

words.en: brisk and cheerful readiness to do something
words.example: She accepted the assignment with an alacrity that surprised her exhausted colleagues.
words.example_zh: 她欣然接受了这项任务，其积极程度让疲惫的同事们感到意外。

words.en: to make suffering or a problem less severe
words.example: The new drainage system did little to alleviate flooding in the lowest neighborhoods.
words.example_zh: 新的排水系统对缓解最低洼社区的洪水几乎没有作用。

words.en: not friendly or forthcoming; distant in manner
words.example: Critics called her aloof, though friends insisted she was simply painfully shy.
words.example_zh: 批评者称她冷淡，但朋友们坚称她只是极度害羞。

words.en: to combine or unite to form one organization or structure
words.example: The two research institutes amalgamated last spring so they could compete for the larger federal grants.
words.example_zh: 两家研究所去年春天合并，以便竞争数额更大的联邦资助。

words.en: open to more than one interpretation
words.example: The contract's ambiguous wording allowed both parties to claim they had won.
words.example_zh: 合同措辞含糊，使双方都能宣称自己赢了。

words.en: having mixed or contradictory feelings about something
words.example: He felt ambivalent about the promotion, eager for the money but dreading the travel.
words.example_zh: 他对升职心情矛盾，渴望加薪却害怕出差。

words.en: to make a bad situation better
words.example: Modest reforms ameliorated working conditions in the mills without addressing any of the industry's deeper problems.
words.example_zh: 温和的改革改善了厂里的工作条件，却未触及该行业任何更深层的问题。

words.en: open and responsive to suggestion or influence
words.example: The landlord proved amenable to a shorter lease once the tenant offered more rent.
words.example_zh: 房东在租客提出加租后，对较短租期表示可以接受。

words.zh: 时代错误；过时的人或物
words.en: something belonging to a period other than the one depicted
words.example: The wristwatch in the medieval scene was an anachronism no editor had caught.
words.example_zh: 中世纪场景中的手表是个没有编辑察觉的时代错误。

words.en: comparable in certain respects to something else
words.example: The immune system is analogous to a standing army, constantly patrolling for intruders.
words.example_zh: 免疫系统类似于一支常备军，不断巡查入侵者。

words.zh: 不得罪人的；平淡的；止痛的
words.en: unlikely to cause offense, and also bland or dull
words.example: His anodyne statement satisfied nobody and revealed nothing about the committee's real disagreements.
words.example_zh: 他四平八稳的声明谁都没满足，也未透露委员会的真实分歧。

words.en: something that deviates from what is standard or expected
words.example: The anomaly in the data turned out to be a faulty sensor rather than a discovery.
words.example_zh: 数据中的异常最终证明是传感器故障，而非什么发现。

words.en: extremely old-fashioned or primitive
words.example: The office still ran on antediluvian software that only two employees could operate.
words.example_zh: 这间办公室仍在使用只有两名员工会操作的陈旧软件。

words.en: a deep-seated feeling of dislike or aversion
words.example: Her antipathy toward committee work kept her out of academic administration entirely.
words.example_zh: 她对委员会工作的反感使她完全远离了学术行政事务。

words.en: lack of interest, enthusiasm, or concern
words.example: Voter apathy rather than organized opposition defeated the referendum in three consecutive elections.
words.example_zh: 使公投在连续三次选举中失败的是选民冷漠，而非有组织的反对。

words.en: widely circulated but probably not true
words.example: The story about the falling apple is charming but almost certainly apocryphal.
words.example_zh: 关于苹果落地的故事很动人，但几乎肯定是虚构的。

words.en: particularly suitable or apt in the circumstances
words.example: She chose an apposite quotation that captured the mood of the entire evening.
words.example_zh: 她选了一句恰如其分的引言，捕捉到了整个晚上的气氛。

words.en: approval or praise, especially official
words.example: The young composer craved the approbation of critics who had ignored his earlier work.
words.example_zh: 这位年轻作曲家渴望那些曾忽视他早期作品的批评家的认可。

words.en: understood by few; mysterious or secret
words.example: Tax law is full of arcane provisions that only specialists can reliably interpret.
words.example_zh: 税法充满晦涩条款，只有专家才能可靠地解读。

words.en: involving strenuous effort; difficult and tiring
words.example: The arduous climb took eleven hours, and two members turned back before the summit.
words.example_zh: 这次艰苦的攀登耗时十一小时，两名成员在登顶前折返了。

words.en: to express an idea fluently and coherently
words.example: Few witnesses could articulate what they had seen with anything like precision.
words.example_zh: 很少有证人能较为准确地表述自己看到的情况。

words.en: practicing severe self-discipline and abstaining from pleasure
words.example: He led an ascetic life in a bare room, owning little beyond his books.
words.example_zh: 他在一间空荡的屋子里过着苦行生活，除了书几乎一无所有。

words.en: an attack on someone's reputation or integrity
words.example: He cast aspersions on his rival's research without offering a single piece of evidence.
words.example_zh: 他诽谤对手的研究，却没有提供一丝证据。

words.en: showing great care, attention, and persistence
words.example: Her assiduous note-taking through two field seasons preserved details that the other researchers had entirely overlooked.
words.example_zh: 她在两个田野季中一丝不苟的笔记保存了其他研究者完全忽略的细节。

words.en: to make an unpleasant feeling less intense
words.example: Nothing the manager said could assuage the crowd's anger over the cancelled concert.
words.example_zh: 经理说的任何话都无法平息人们对演唱会取消的愤怒。

words.en: having sharp judgment and practical shrewdness
words.example: An astute reader will notice that the narrator contradicts himself in the second chapter.
words.example_zh: 敏锐的读者会注意到叙述者在第二章自相矛盾。

words.en: relating to the reappearance of an ancestral trait
words.example: Crowds sometimes display an atavistic fear that no amount of reasoning dispels.
words.example_zh: 人群有时表现出一种任何说理都无法消除的原始恐惧。

words.en: to reduce the force, effect, or thickness of
words.example: Distance and thick concrete walls attenuated the signal until the receiver could no longer decode it.
words.example_zh: 距离和厚混凝土墙削弱了信号，直到接收器再也无法解码。

words.en: showing a willingness to take surprisingly bold risks
words.example: The audacious plan required crossing the desert on foot with only four days of water.
words.example_zh: 这个大胆的计划要求仅带四天的饮水徒步穿越沙漠。

words.en: to make something greater by adding to it
words.example: She augmented her teaching income by editing manuscripts late into the night.
words.example_zh: 她靠深夜编辑书稿来增加自己的教学收入。

words.en: conducive to success; giving signs of a favorable outcome
words.example: Clear skies and a full house made for an auspicious opening night.
words.example_zh: 晴朗的天空和满座的观众让首演之夜显得吉兆连连。

words.en: severe or plain in appearance or manner
words.example: The austere concrete chapel moved visitors far more than its ornate predecessor had.
words.example_zh: 这座朴素的混凝土礼拜堂比它华丽的前身更能感染参观者。

words.en: acting independently or having the freedom to do so
words.example: Each regional office remained autonomous, setting its own budget and hiring policies.
words.example_zh: 各地区办事处保持自治，自行制定预算和招聘政策。

words.en: extreme greed for wealth or material gain
words.example: The novel treats avarice as a disease that consumes families across three generations.
words.example_zh: 这部小说把贪婪写成一种吞噬三代家庭的疾病。

words.en: to state or assert something as a fact
words.example: The defendant averred that he had never entered the building on that night.
words.example_zh: 被告断言他那天晚上从未进入该建筑。

words.en: kind and friendly toward younger people, like an uncle
words.example: His avuncular manner put nervous first-year students at ease within the first ten minutes of class.
words.example_zh: 他叔伯般慈祥的态度在课程头十分钟内就让紧张的一年级学生放松下来。

words.en: so lacking in originality as to be boring
words.example: Beneath its striking imagery the poem offers a moral so banal that students laugh at it.
words.example_zh: 在惊人的意象之下，这首诗给出的道德训诫平庸得让学生发笑。

words.en: to fail to give a true impression of something
words.example: His calm voice belied the panic he felt as the engine sputtered.
words.example_zh: 他平静的声音掩盖了引擎失灵时他内心的恐慌。

words.en: demonstrating aggression and willingness to fight
words.example: The ambassador's bellicose speech alarmed allies who had expected several weeks of quiet diplomacy instead.
words.example_zh: 大使好战的演讲让原本期待数周低调外交的盟友深感不安。

words.en: generous and doing good to others
words.example: The beneficent donor funded the library but refused to have it named after him.
words.example_zh: 这位仁慈的捐赠者资助了图书馆，却拒绝以自己的名字命名。

words.en: to leave property or a legacy to someone by will
words.example: She bequeathed her entire mineral collection to the university she never attended.
words.example_zh: 她把全部矿石收藏遗赠给了自己从未就读的那所大学。

words.en: deprived of or lacking something
words.example: After the fire the town was bereft of both records and photographs.
words.example_zh: 大火之后，这座小镇既失去了档案也失去了照片。

words.en: flattery intended to persuade someone
words.example: No amount of blandishment could persuade the old editor to reconsider the manuscript.
words.example_zh: 再多的奉承也无法说服这位老编辑重新考虑那份书稿。

words.en: done openly and unashamedly
words.example: The report contained blatant errors that a single afternoon of checking would have caught.
words.example_zh: 报告中有明显的错误，只需一个下午的核查就能发现。

words.en: to support or strengthen something
words.example: New excavations bolstered the theory that the settlement was primarily a trading post.
words.example_zh: 新的发掘支持了该聚落主要是贸易站的理论。

words.zh: 夸夸其谈的；华而不实的
words.en: high-sounding but with little meaning
words.example: His bombastic prose impressed few readers and irritated most of his reviewers.
words.example_zh: 他夸夸其谈的文风打动的读者寥寥，却激怒了多数评论者。

words.en: rough and bad-mannered
words.example: Guests forgave his boorish jokes only because the food arriving from that kitchen was extraordinary.
words.example_zh: 客人们原谅他粗鲁的玩笑，只因那间厨房送出的食物实在美味。

words.en: concise and exact use of words or short duration
words.example: The brevity of the announcement suggested that the board had something to hide.
words.example_zh: 公告的简短暗示董事会有事情要隐瞒。

words.en: relating to the pleasant aspects of the countryside
words.example: The painting's bucolic calm concealed the brutal labor that farming actually demanded.
words.example_zh: 画中田园般的宁静掩盖了农耕实际需要的繁重劳作。

words.en: to begin to grow or increase rapidly
words.example: Coastal tourism burgeoned after the highway opened, doubling the town's population in summer.
words.example_zh: 公路通车后沿海旅游业迅速发展，夏季小镇人口翻了一倍。

words.en: to polish, or to improve a reputation
words.example: The award did more to burnish the university's image than to help the researcher.
words.example_zh: 这个奖项对美化大学形象的作用大于对研究者本人的帮助。

words.en: a harsh, discordant mixture of sounds
words.example: A cacophony of horns and shouting rose from the street below the hotel window.
words.example_zh: 酒店窗下的街道传来喇叭声和喊叫声混成的刺耳嘈杂。

words.en: to persuade someone by sustained coaxing or flattery
words.example: She cajoled her brother into driving four hours to the airport at midnight.
words.example_zh: 她哄着弟弟在午夜开四小时车去机场。

words.en: showing an insensitive disregard for others' feelings
words.example: His callous remark about the layoffs cost him whatever loyalty the night shift still felt.
words.example_zh: 他关于裁员的冷漠言论让他失去了夜班工人残存的一切忠诚。

words.en: truthful and straightforward, even when uncomfortable
words.example: In a rare candid moment the director admitted the film's ending never worked.
words.example_zh: 在难得的坦率时刻，导演承认这部电影的结尾从未成功。

words.en: accepted as authoritative or standard
words.example: The canonical version of the text differs substantially from the manuscript she found.
words.example_zh: 该文本的权威版本与她发现的手稿有实质性差异。

words.en: given to sudden, unpredictable changes of mood or behavior
words.example: The capricious editor accepted essays on Monday and rejected identical ones on Friday.
words.example_zh: 这位反复无常的编辑周一接受的文章，周五又拒了同样的稿子。

words.en: to reprimand someone severely
words.example: Reviewers castigated the study for ignoring several datasets that plainly contradicted its published conclusions.
words.example_zh: 评审严厉批评该研究忽视了几组明显与其发表结论矛盾的数据。

words.en: something that precipitates an event or change
words.example: The strike became the catalyst for reforms the legislature had resisted for years.
words.example_zh: 这次罢工成了立法机构多年抵制的改革的催化剂。

words.en: sarcastic and biting, or chemically corrosive
words.example: Her caustic wit made her feared at conferences and beloved in private.
words.example_zh: 她讥讽的机智让她在会议上令人畏惧，在私下里深受喜爱。

words.en: to express severe disapproval, often formally
words.example: The senate voted to censure the official for concealing the audit results.
words.example_zh: 参议院投票谴责该官员隐瞒审计结果。

words.en: the use of trickery to achieve a purpose
words.example: Legal chicanery delayed the trial for six years while witnesses grew old.
words.example_zh: 法律上的诡计把审判拖延了六年，期间证人逐渐老去。

words.en: the use of many words where fewer would do
words.example: Her answer was pure circumlocution, and after ten minutes nobody knew her position.
words.example_zh: 她的回答纯属绕圈子，十分钟后没人知道她的立场。

words.en: wary and unwilling to take risks
words.example: Investors grew circumspect after two of the region's banks failed in one month.
words.example_zh: 在该地区一个月内两家银行倒闭后，投资者变得谨慎。

words.en: kept secret, especially because illicit
words.example: Their clandestine meetings continued for months before a security guard reported them.
words.example_zh: 他们的秘密会面持续了数月，之后才被一名保安报告。

words.en: to come together to form one mass or whole
words.example: Scattered protests coalesced into a movement that no official could safely ignore.
words.example_zh: 零散的抗议汇聚成一场没有官员能安全忽视的运动。

words.zh: 有说服力的；令人信服的
words.en: clear, logical, and convincing
words.example: She offered a cogent argument that changed the minds of three skeptical reviewers.
words.example_zh: 她提出了一个有说服力的论证，改变了三位持怀疑态度评审的看法。

words.en: corresponding in size, extent, or degree
words.example: The punishment seemed hardly commensurate with an offense as trivial as a late library book.
words.example_zh: 这样的惩罚与晚还一本图书这类轻微过失似乎很不相称。

words.en: a concise collection of information on a subject
words.example: The volume is a compendium of folk remedies collected across four rural provinces.
words.example_zh: 这卷书是在四个农业省份收集的民间药方汇编。

words.en: smugly satisfied with oneself and unaware of danger
words.example: Three profitable years made the firm complacent about competitors it once studied closely.
words.example_zh: 三年的盈利让这家公司对曾经密切研究的竞争者变得自满。

words.en: inclined to agree with others or obey rules
words.example: A compliant board approved every proposal the chairman put before it for nearly nine years.
words.example_zh: 顺从的董事会近九年来批准了主席提交的每一项提案。

words.en: intended to placate or reconcile
words.example: His conciliatory tone surprised delegates who had arrived expecting another round of public accusations.
words.example_zh: 他安抚的语气让那些预期又一轮公开指责的代表们感到意外。

words.en: to accept or overlook behavior that is wrong
words.example: The school refused to condone cheating even when the student's circumstances were desperate.
words.example_zh: 即使学生处境窘迫，学校也拒绝容忍作弊。

words.en: to confuse or mix up, or to prove wrong
words.example: The results confounded researchers who had confidently predicted the opposite effect in every published model.
words.example_zh: 这些结果让在每个已发表模型中都自信预测相反效应的研究者困惑不已。

words.en: pleasant because of qualities that suit one's taste
words.example: He found the small college a congenial place to finish his long-delayed book.
words.example_zh: 他发现这所小学院是完成拖延已久的著作的宜人之地。

words.en: an expert judge in matters of taste
words.example: Only a connoisseur would notice that the frame postdates the painting by a century.
words.example_zh: 只有鉴赏家才会注意到画框比画作晚了一个世纪。

words.en: to declare something sacred or devote it to a purpose
words.example: The ground had been consecrated long before the surrounding town or its market ever existed.
words.example_zh: 这片土地在周围的城镇及其集市出现之前很久就已被奉为圣地。

words.en: showing the highest skill, or to bring to completion
words.example: A consummate diplomat, she managed to please delegations that despised each other.
words.example_zh: 作为完美的外交家，她设法让互相憎恶的代表团都感到满意。

words.en: causing or likely to cause disagreement
words.example: Water rights remain the most contentious issue between the two neighboring states.
words.example_zh: 水权仍是两个邻州之间最有争议的问题。

words.en: feeling remorse for a wrong committed
words.example: He seemed genuinely contrite, though the apology arrived three years too late.
words.example_zh: 他看来真心悔悟，尽管道歉迟到了三年。

words.en: a confusing and difficult problem
words.example: The conundrum facing planners was how to add housing without destroying the wetlands.
words.example_zh: 规划者面临的难题是如何在不破坏湿地的情况下增加住房。

words.en: friendly, lively, and enjoyable in atmosphere
words.example: The convivial dinner ran until two, and nobody remembered the original argument.
words.example_zh: 欢快的晚餐持续到凌晨两点，没人记得最初的争论了。

words.en: abundant in supply or quantity
words.example: Copious rainfall in April rescued a harvest that had appeared doomed only weeks earlier.
words.example_zh: 四月的充沛降雨挽救了几周前还看似注定失败的收成。

words.en: to confirm or give support to a statement or finding
words.example: Two independent laboratories in different countries corroborated the finding within the same academic year.
words.example_zh: 两个不同国家的独立实验室在同一学年内证实了这一发现。

words.en: familiar with and at ease in many cultures
words.example: The port city was thoroughly cosmopolitan for centuries before the phrase itself became fashionable.
words.example_zh: 这座港口城市在这个词本身流行之前的数百年就已彻底国际化。

words.en: contemptibly lacking in courage
words.example: His craven silence during the hearing disappointed everyone who had trusted him.
words.example_zh: 他在听证会上怯懦的沉默让所有信任过他的人失望。

words.en: too ready to believe things; easily deceived
words.example: The scheme succeeded because credulous investors never asked to see audited statements.
words.example_zh: 这个骗局之所以成功，是因为轻信的投资者从未要求查看审计报表。

words.en: having a hidden or ambiguous meaning
words.example: Her cryptic note said only that the meeting had been moved somewhere safer.
words.example_zh: 她那张含义模糊的便条只写着会面已改到更安全的地方。

words.en: deserving blame for a fault or wrongdoing
words.example: The inquiry found the contractor culpable for ignoring three separate warnings from safety inspectors.
words.example_zh: 调查认定承包商因忽视安全检查员三次单独警告而应受责备。

words.en: hasty and not thorough
words.example: Even a cursory reading reveals that the two chapters contradict each other.
words.example_zh: 即使粗略一读也能看出这两章自相矛盾。

words.en: a scarcity or lack of something
words.example: A dearth of primary sources makes the period nearly impossible to reconstruct.
words.example_zh: 一手史料的缺乏使这一时期几乎无法重建。

words.en: a sudden and humiliating failure
words.example: The launch became a debacle when the software failed in front of reporters.
words.example_zh: 当软件在记者面前崩溃时，这次发布会变成了一场惨败。

words.en: to reduce the quality, value, or dignity of
words.example: Flooding the market with imitations debased a currency that had held value for centuries.
words.example_zh: 大量仿制品涌入市场，使一种保值数百年的货币贬值。

words.en: to expose the falseness of a belief or claim
words.example: The article debunked a myth that textbooks had repeated for forty years.
words.example_zh: 这篇文章揭穿了教科书重复了四十年的一个神话。

words.en: in keeping with good taste and propriety
words.example: The ceremony was so decorous and so carefully timed that it became genuinely dull.
words.example_zh: 典礼如此得体、时间安排如此精确，以至于变得真正乏味。

words.en: respectful submission to another's judgment
words.example: Out of deference to the founder, nobody questioned the plan for another decade.
words.example_zh: 出于对创始人的尊重，又有十年无人质疑这个计划。

words.en: causing harm or damage
words.example: Prolonged drought had deleterious effects on soil that fertilizer could not undo.
words.example_zh: 长期干旱对土壤造成了肥料无法弥补的有害影响。

words.en: to describe or portray something precisely
words.example: The treaty carefully delineates each nation's fishing rights along the disputed coast.
words.example_zh: 条约细致界定了各国在争议海岸的捕鱼权。

words.en: to raise objections or show reluctance
words.example: When asked to sign the joint statement, two of the senior scientists quietly demurred.
words.example_zh: 被要求签署联合声明时，两位资深科学家悄然表示了异议。

words.en: to criticize unfairly or disparage
words.example: He built his reputation partly by denigrating the work of older colleagues.
words.example_zh: 他的声望部分建立在贬低年长同事的工作之上。

words.en: to express contempt for; to ridicule
words.example: Critics derided the design as a warehouse pretending to be a museum.
words.example_zh: 批评者嘲笑这个设计是假装成博物馆的仓库。

words.en: to remove the moisture from something
words.example: Decades of upstream irrigation desiccated wetlands that had once supported thousands of migrating birds.
words.example_zh: 数十年的上游灌溉使曾支撑数千只候鸟的湿地干涸。

words.en: lacking a plan or purpose; going randomly from one thing to another
words.example: Their desultory conversation wandered from property taxes to birdwatching without ever settling anywhere.
words.example_zh: 他们散漫的谈话从房产税扯到观鸟，始终没有落定在任何话题上。

words.en: light, delicate, and translucent
words.example: The diaphanous curtains let in light while hiding the courtyard from view.
words.example_zh: 轻薄透光的窗帘透进光线，同时遮住了庭院。

words.en: a forceful and bitter verbal attack
words.example: His diatribe against standardized testing filled eleven pages and persuaded almost nobody.
words.example_zh: 他对标准化考试的痛斥写了十一页，却几乎没说服任何人。

words.en: intended to teach, often excessively moralizing
words.example: The novel turns didactic in its final chapters, lecturing readers it had trusted before.
words.example_zh: 小说在最后几章变得说教，开始向此前信任的读者训话。

words.en: modest or shy from lack of self-confidence
words.example: Too diffident to defend her findings, she let a louder colleague take credit.
words.example_zh: 她因过于羞怯而不为自己的发现辩护，让一位更强势的同事占了功劳。

words.en: to depart from the main subject temporarily
words.example: The professor digressed for twenty minutes about his years in the merchant marine.
words.example_zh: 教授离题二十分钟，讲他在商船队的岁月。

words.en: slow to act; intended to cause delay
words.example: Dilatory tactics kept the case out of court until the statute expired.
words.example_zh: 拖延战术使案件在诉讼时效届满前一直未能开庭。

words.en: showing steady, earnest effort in one's work
words.example: Diligent record-keeping by a single clerk preserved the town archive through two devastating floods.
words.example_zh: 一位职员勤勉的记录工作使镇上的档案经历两次毁灭性洪水而留存。

words.en: to free someone from a mistaken belief
words.example: A week in the laboratory disabused him of any romance about scientific work.
words.example_zh: 在实验室的一周让他对科研工作的浪漫想象彻底醒悟。

words.en: to perceive or recognize something with difficulty
words.example: It was hard to discern any pattern in the first month of readings.
words.example_zh: 在第一个月的读数中很难辨出任何规律。

words.en: disagreeing or incongruous, especially in sound
words.example: A discordant note in the report suggested the authors disagreed more than they admitted.
words.example_zh: 报告中一处不协调之处暗示作者们的分歧比承认的更大。

words.en: to harm the reputation or credibility of
words.example: The forged letters were designed to discredit a witness the defense feared.
words.example_zh: 这些伪造信件意在让辩方害怕的一名证人丧失信誉。

words.en: individually separate and distinct
words.example: The disease progresses through four discrete stages, each of which requires a different treatment.
words.example_zh: 该疾病经过四个独立阶段发展，每个阶段都需要不同的治疗。

words.en: not candid; pretending ignorance or sincerity
words.example: It was disingenuous of him to claim surprise at figures he had personally reviewed.
words.example_zh: 他对自己亲自审阅过的数字声称吃惊，实属虚伪。

words.en: to speak of someone or something slightingly
words.example: She never disparaged rival theories, preferring to test them fairly in print.
words.example_zh: 她从不贬损对立理论，宁愿在文章中公平检验它们。

words.en: essentially different in kind and not comparable
words.example: The study draws on disparate fields, ranging from historical linguistics to hydraulic engineering.
words.example_zh: 该研究借鉴了从历史语言学到水利工程等全然不同的领域。

words.en: to conceal one's true motives or feelings
words.example: He dissembled skillfully, expressing sympathy for a plan he intended to block.
words.example_zh: 他巧妙地掩饰，对自己打算阻止的计划表示同情。

words.en: to spread information or ideas widely
words.example: Cheap pamphlets disseminated the findings far faster than any academic journal could have managed.
words.example_zh: 廉价的小册子传播这些发现的速度远快于任何学术期刊所能达到的。

words.en: a lack of harmony or agreement
words.example: The dissonance between the company's stated values and its practices embarrassed employees.
words.example_zh: 公司宣称的价值观与其做法之间的不协调让员工尴尬。

words.en: asserting opinions as if they were beyond dispute
words.example: His dogmatic insistence on one method drove away his most creative students.
words.example_zh: 他教条式地坚持一种方法，赶走了最有创造力的学生。

words.en: temporarily inactive or in a state of rest
words.example: The volcano lay dormant for nearly three centuries before the tremors resumed last autumn.
words.example_zh: 这座火山休眠近三个世纪，去年秋天震动才重新开始。

words.en: hesitating or doubting; of questionable value
words.example: The manuscript's provenance is dubious, and three dealers refused to handle it.
words.example_zh: 该手稿的来历可疑，三位经销商都拒绝经手。

words.zh: 热情洋溢的；兴高采烈的
words.en: cheerful and full of energy
words.example: The ebullient conductor kept the whole orchestra rehearsing happily until well past midnight.
words.example_zh: 热情洋溢的指挥让整个乐团愉快地排练到午夜过后很久。

words.en: deriving ideas or style from a broad range of sources
words.example: Her eclectic library mixed medieval theology with technical manuals on bridge and tunnel construction.
words.example_zh: 她博采众长的藏书把中世纪神学与桥梁隧道建造的技术手册混在一起。

words.en: effective in producing the desired result
words.example: The remedy proved efficacious in trials but far too expensive for general use.
words.example_zh: 该疗法在试验中证明有效，但对普遍使用而言过于昂贵。

words.en: insolent or impertinent behavior
words.example: He had the effrontery to request a raise a week after the audit.
words.example_zh: 审计后一周他就厚颜无耻地要求加薪。

words.en: outstandingly bad; shocking
words.example: The egregious errors in translation reversed the meaning of two key clauses.
words.example_zh: 翻译中的严重错误使两个关键条款的含义完全相反。

words.en: a mournful poem, typically a lament for the dead
words.example: The essay reads less like history than like an elegy for a vanished trade.
words.example_zh: 这篇文章读起来不像历史，更像是对一门消逝行业的挽歌。

words.en: to draw out a response or information from someone
words.example: The question elicited a long silence and then a very careful answer.
words.example_zh: 这个问题引出了长久的沉默，随后是一个非常谨慎的回答。

words.en: fluent and persuasive in speaking or writing
words.example: Her eloquent testimony changed the tone of hearings that had grown routine.
words.example_zh: 她雄辩的证词改变了已流于例行的听证会的气氛。

words.en: to make something clear by explaining it
words.example: A single well-drawn diagram elucidated what three pages of dense prose had thoroughly obscured.
words.example_zh: 一张绘制精良的图表阐明了三页密集文字彻底模糊掉的内容。

words.en: abnormally thin or weak from illness or hunger
words.example: The emaciated cattle told investigators far more than the rancher's carefully kept records did.
words.example_zh: 消瘦的牛群向调查者透露的信息远多于牧场主精心保存的记录。

words.en: to make more attractive by adding detail, often invented
words.example: He embellished the story each time he told it, until nothing remained verifiable.
words.example_zh: 他每讲一次故事就添加渲染，直到无一处可以核实。

words.en: based on observation or experiment rather than theory
words.example: The claim sounded plausible enough but rested on no empirical evidence of any kind.
words.example_zh: 这一主张听来足够合理，却毫无任何实证依据。

words.en: to imitate someone or something admired
words.example: Younger architects emulated his use of light without grasping its structural logic.
words.example_zh: 年轻建筑师效仿他对光的运用，却未领会其结构逻辑。

words.en: regularly found in a particular place or group
words.example: The bird is endemic to two islands and found nowhere else on earth.
words.example_zh: 这种鸟仅见于两个岛屿，地球上其他地方都没有。

words.en: to drain of energy or vitality
words.example: The relentless heat enervated the crew long before the work was finished.
words.example_zh: 持续不断的酷热在工作完成前很久就使工人们精疲力竭。

words.en: to cause or give rise to a feeling or situation
words.example: Secrecy about the audit engendered exactly the suspicion that the committee had hoped to avoid.
words.example_zh: 对审计的保密恰恰引发了委员会希望避免的猜疑。

words.en: difficult to interpret or understand; mysterious
words.example: His enigmatic smile left the interviewers uncertain whether he had actually agreed to anything.
words.example_zh: 他神秘的微笑让面试官不确定他是否真的同意了任何事。

words.en: lasting for a very short time
words.example: Fame in that industry is ephemeral, and most careers last under four years.
words.example_zh: 那个行业的名气是短暂的，大多数职业生涯不到四年。

words.en: calmness and composure, especially under strain
words.example: She received the verdict with an equanimity that unsettled the reporters present.
words.example_zh: 她以让在场记者不安的镇定接受了判决。

words.en: to use ambiguous language to avoid commitment
words.example: Pressed repeatedly for a firm date, the minister equivocated for nearly ten full minutes.
words.example_zh: 被反复追问确切日期时，部长含糊其辞了近整十分钟。

words.en: having or showing great knowledge from study
words.example: The erudite footnotes occupied far more space on the page than the argument they supported.
words.example_zh: 博学的脚注在页面上占据的篇幅远超它们所支持的论证。

words.en: to deliberately avoid or abstain from something
words.example: The filmmaker eschews music entirely, relying instead on ambient sound throughout the entire film.
words.example_zh: 这位导演完全弃用音乐，全片改为依靠环境声。

words.zh: 深奥的；只有内行才懂的
words.en: intended for or understood by only a small group
words.example: The debate remained esoteric until a newspaper explained its consequences for pensions.
words.example_zh: 在一家报纸解释其对养老金的影响之前，这场辩论一直很深奥。

words.en: to adopt or support a cause or belief
words.example: He espoused free trade in public while quietly lobbying several ministers for protective tariffs.
words.example_zh: 他在公开场合拥护自由贸易，私下却向多位部长游说保护性关税。

words.en: extremely delicate and seemingly not of this world
words.example: The soprano's ethereal tone carried clearly to the last row without any amplification at all.
words.example_zh: 女高音超凡的音色未经任何扩音就清晰传到了最后一排。

words.en: a mild word substituted for one considered harsh
words.example: Calling the layoffs a restructuring was a euphemism nobody in the office accepted.
words.example_zh: 把裁员称为重组，是办公室里没人接受的委婉说法。

words.en: quickly fading from sight or memory
words.example: The evanescent glow lasted only a few seconds, and no instrument on site recorded it.
words.example_zh: 那转瞬即逝的光芒只持续几秒，现场没有仪器记录到它。

words.en: to make a problem or bad situation worse
words.example: The emergency loan exacerbated the debt problem it was meant to solve.
words.example_zh: 这笔紧急贷款加剧了它本应解决的债务问题。

words.en: to show that someone is not guilty of wrongdoing
words.example: The recovered logbook finally exculpated the pilot who had been blamed for nearly a decade.
words.example_zh: 找回的航行日志最终为被指责近十年的飞行员开脱了罪责。

words.en: pressing; demanding immediate attention
words.example: Only genuinely exigent circumstances can justify entering a private residence without a signed warrant.
words.example_zh: 只有真正紧急的情况才能正当化在无签署搜查令下进入私人住宅。

words.en: to absolve someone from blame or an obligation
words.example: New forensic evidence exonerated the two men after nineteen years in a maximum-security prison.
words.example_zh: 新的法医证据在两人于重刑监狱服刑十九年后证明了他们的清白。

words.en: convenient and practical though possibly improper
words.example: Closing the branch was expedient, but it cost the bank its oldest customers.
words.example_zh: 关闭分行是权宜之计，却让银行失去了最老的客户。

words.en: to make a process happen more quickly
words.example: A single phone call expedited paperwork that had sat idle for months.
words.example_zh: 一个电话就加快了闲置数月的文书流程。

words.en: to erase or remove completely
words.example: The court finally agreed to expunge the old conviction from his record entirely.
words.example_zh: 法院最终同意将这项旧的定罪从他的记录中彻底删除。

words.en: still in existence; surviving
words.example: Only four extant copies of the pamphlet survive, all in private hands.
words.example_zh: 这本小册子仅存四本，都在私人手中。

words.en: to praise enthusiastically
words.example: Reviewers extolled the new translation while quietly ignoring the many omissions in its later chapters.
words.example_zh: 评论者盛赞这个新译本，却默默忽略了其后面章节中的诸多删略。

words.en: irrelevant or unrelated to the subject at hand
words.example: Cutting extraneous detail reduced the report by half without losing anything essential.
words.example_zh: 删去无关细节使报告缩短一半，却未丢失任何要点。

words.en: to infer unknown values by extending known data
words.example: It is risky to extrapolate national trends from a single city's records.
words.example_zh: 从一座城市的记录推断全国趋势是有风险的。

words.en: treating serious matters with inappropriate humor
words.example: His facetious answer during the deposition irritated the judge and alarmed his own lawyer.
words.example_zh: 他在取证时不严肃的回答激怒了法官，也让自己的律师警觉。

words.en: appearing neat but ignoring real complexities
words.example: The facile explanation satisfied readers who had never examined the data behind it.
words.example_zh: 这种肤浅的解释满足了从未审视其背后数据的读者。

words.en: based on a mistaken belief or faulty reasoning
words.example: The argument is fallacious because it treats correlation as proof of cause.
words.example_zh: 这个论证是谬误的，因为它把相关性当作因果证明。

words.en: very attentive to accuracy and detail; hard to please
words.example: A fastidious editor, she questioned every comma and nearly every adjective in the manuscript.
words.example_zh: 作为一丝不苟的编辑，她质疑手稿中的每个逗号和几乎每个形容词。

words.en: silly and pointless in a self-satisfied way
words.example: His fatuous remarks about the housing crisis were quoted against him for years afterward.
words.example_zh: 他关于住房危机的愚蠢言论此后多年被用来反驳他自己。

words.en: producing abundantly; highly fertile or inventive
words.example: That decade was remarkably fecund for him, yielding four novels and two full-length plays.
words.example_zh: 那十年对他异常多产，产出了四部小说和两部长篇戏剧。

words.en: well chosen or suited to the circumstances
words.example: The title was a felicitous choice that summarized the book in three words.
words.example_zh: 这个书名选得恰到好处，用三个词概括了全书。

words.en: having or showing intense feeling
words.example: A fervent defender of public libraries, he spoke at every budget hearing.
words.example_zh: 作为公共图书馆的热情捍卫者，他在每次预算听证会上发言。

words.en: to become tired or less vigorous
words.example: Attendance flagged after the second week, and the series was quietly cancelled.
words.example_zh: 第二周后出席人数下降，这个系列活动被悄然取消。

words.en: excessively ornate or elaborate in style
words.example: His florid prose buries several good observations under three or four adjectives each.
words.example_zh: 他华丽的文风把若干好的观察各埋在三四个形容词之下。

words.en: to openly disregard a rule or convention
words.example: Several large firms flouted the regulation for years without receiving a single financial penalty.
words.example_zh: 几家大公司多年公然违反该规定，却未收到一次经济处罚。

words.en: to prevent something by taking action in advance
words.example: Early and thorough inspections forestalled a failure that would have closed the bridge for months.
words.example_zh: 早期彻底的检查预先阻止了一场本会使大桥关闭数月的故障。

words.en: happening by chance, often luckily
words.example: Their meeting was fortuitous, arranged by a delayed train rather than design.
words.example_zh: 他们的相遇是偶然的，由一班晚点列车而非刻意安排促成。

words.en: irritable and quarrelsome; difficult to control
words.example: The fractious governing coalition collapsed within a single year of finally taking office.
words.example_zh: 这个内部不和的执政联盟在终于上台后一年内就崩溃了。

words.en: sparing or economical with money and resources
words.example: Frugal habits learned in childhood stayed with her long after she grew wealthy.
words.example_zh: 童年养成的节俭习惯在她富裕之后仍长久保留。

words.en: attempting to avoid notice; secretive
words.example: A furtive glance toward the door betrayed his intention to leave early.
words.example_zh: 他偷偷瞥向门口，暴露了想提早离开的意图。

words.en: excessively talkative, especially about trivia
words.example: The garrulous guide talked through every silence that the ancient ruins clearly deserved.
words.example_zh: 喋喋不休的导游填满了这些古老遗址明显应享有的每段静默。

words.en: relevant to a subject under consideration
words.example: The chair ruled that the objection was not germane to the motion.
words.example_zh: 主席裁定该反对意见与该动议无关。

words.en: pompous or extravagant in language or style
words.example: The grandiloquent introduction lasted considerably longer than the modest lecture it was meant to announce.
words.example_zh: 浮夸的开场介绍比它本要引出的那场朴素讲座长得多。

words.zh: 无端的；不必要的；免费的
words.en: uncalled for; without good reason
words.example: The gratuitous insult in the footnote had nothing to do with the argument.
words.example_zh: 脚注中无端的侮辱与论证毫无关系。

words.en: fond of company; sociable
words.example: Gregarious by nature, he knew every neighbor and shopkeeper within three surrounding streets.
words.example_zh: 他天性爱交际，认识周围三条街内的每位邻居和店主。

words.en: sly or cunning intelligence
words.example: She won the long negotiation through patience and preparation rather than guile.
words.example_zh: 她靠耐心和准备而非诡计赢得了这场漫长的谈判。

words.en: overused and therefore lacking freshness
words.example: The commencement speech relied on hackneyed metaphors about journeys, mountains, and open doors.
words.example_zh: 毕业演讲依赖关于旅程、山峰和敞开之门的老套隐喻。

words.en: a lengthy and aggressive speech
words.example: His nightly harangue about punctuality achieved nothing except a general resentment among the staff.
words.example_zh: 他每晚关于守时的长篇训斥除了在员工中造成普遍怨恨一无所获。

words.en: a sign that something is about to happen
words.example: Falling bond yields were an early harbinger of the slowdown that arrived that winter.
words.example_zh: 债券收益率下降是那年冬天到来的经济放缓的早期预兆。

words.en: a belief that contradicts accepted doctrine
words.example: Suggesting that the founder had erred was treated as heresy inside that small department.
words.example_zh: 在那个小系里，提出创始人有错被当作异端。

words.en: leadership or dominance of one group over others
words.example: Regional hegemony rested on control of two rivers and a mountain pass.
words.example_zh: 该地区的霸权建立在对两条河流和一处山口的控制之上。

words.en: not conforming with accepted standards or beliefs
words.example: Her heterodox views on inflation were ridiculed for years and later widely adopted.
words.example_zh: 她关于通胀的非正统观点被嘲笑多年，后来被广泛采纳。

words.en: exaggerated statements not meant literally
words.example: Calling the delay catastrophic was hyperbole, though the stranded passengers were understandably angry.
words.example_zh: 把延误称为灾难是夸张，尽管滞留乘客的愤怒可以理解。

words.zh: 打破传统者；偶像破坏者
words.en: a person who attacks cherished beliefs or institutions
words.example: An iconoclast in a conservative field, he questioned assumptions nobody else touched.
words.example_zh: 作为保守领域中的破旧者，他质疑无人触碰的假设。

words.en: peculiar to an individual; distinctive and unusual
words.example: His idiosyncratic filing system made perfect sense to nobody in the office but himself.
words.example_zh: 他古怪的归档系统在办公室里除了他自己没人完全看得懂。

words.en: deserving or causing public disgrace
words.example: The campaign ended in ignominious defeat a week after the recordings surfaced online.
words.example_zh: 录音在网上曝光一周后，这场竞选以不光彩的失败告终。

words.en: unchanging over time and unable to be altered
words.example: What the textbook called immutable law turned out to hold only approximately.
words.example_zh: 教科书称为不变定律的东西最终只是近似成立。

words.en: not feeling or showing emotion
words.example: The witness remained impassive through nearly four hours of increasingly hostile cross-examination.
words.example_zh: 证人在近四小时越发充满敌意的交叉质询中始终面无表情。

words.en: having little or no money
words.example: The impecunious young painter traded finished canvases for meals for nearly two years.
words.example_zh: 这位贫穷的年轻画家用完成的画作换饭吃了近两年。

words.en: unable to be upset or excited; calm
words.example: The imperturbable pilot landed the crippled aircraft safely without ever raising her voice.
words.example_zh: 沉着的飞行员从未提高嗓门就让受损飞机安全着陆。

words.en: unable to be affected or penetrated
words.example: He seemed impervious to criticism, revising nothing at all across five successive editions.
words.example_zh: 他似乎对批评毫不动摇，五个连续版本中什么都没改。

words.zh: 无法安抚的；坚定不移的
words.en: unable to be appeased or placated
words.example: The company faced an implacable opponent in a neighborhood association with excellent lawyers.
words.example_zh: 公司在一个拥有优秀律师的社区协会那里遇到了不可安抚的对手。

words.en: suggested but not directly expressed
words.example: There was an implicit threat in the letter that no sentence stated openly.
words.example_zh: 信中有一种没有任何句子明说的隐含威胁。

words.en: to ask someone persistently and annoyingly
words.example: Donors importuned by three letters every week eventually stopped opening the envelopes at all.
words.example_zh: 每周被三封信强求的捐赠者最终完全不再打开信封。

words.en: to call into question the integrity or validity of
words.example: He never impugned her motives in print; he questioned only her statistical methods.
words.example_zh: 他从未在文章中质疑她的动机，只质疑她的统计方法。

words.en: not resulting from deliberate intention
words.example: An inadvertent omission in the footnotes triggered several months of accusations and denials.
words.example_zh: 脚注中一处无意的遗漏引发了数月的指责与否认。

words.en: just begun and not fully formed
words.example: His inchoate theory needed two more years before it could be tested.
words.example_zh: 他初步的理论还需两年才能接受检验。

words.en: in an initial stage; beginning to appear
words.example: Doctors caught the incipient infection early, well before it could reach the bloodstream.
words.example_zh: 医生及早发现了初期感染，远在它进入血液之前。

words.en: not important or significant
words.example: The differences between the two drafts were inconsequential except to the lawyers reviewing them.
words.example_zh: 两份草案之间的差异除了对审阅它们的律师之外都无关紧要。

words.en: not able to be denied or disputed
words.example: The aerial photographs provided incontrovertible proof of the settlement's original layout and boundaries.
words.example_zh: 这些航拍照片提供了该聚落原始布局与边界的确凿证据。

words.zh: 不可救药的；屡教不改的
words.en: not able to be corrected or reformed
words.example: An incorrigible optimist, she rebuilt the shop after each of three fires.
words.example_zh: 作为不可救药的乐观者，她在三次火灾后每次都重建店铺。

words.en: originating naturally in a particular place
words.example: The plant is indigenous to high valleys and dies quickly at sea level.
words.example_zh: 这种植物原产于高海拔谷地，在海平面高度会迅速死亡。

words.en: wanting to avoid activity or exertion; lazy
words.example: Critics called the second act indolent, as though the writer had lost interest.
words.example_zh: 批评者称第二幕懈怠，仿佛作者已失去兴趣。

words.zh: 难以言表的；无法形容的
words.en: too great or extreme to be expressed in words
words.example: She described the summit view as ineffable and then talked about it for hours.
words.example_zh: 她称山顶景色难以言表，然后又谈了几个小时。

words.en: having or showing no skill; clumsy
words.example: The inept scheduling left three surgeons idle and one working double shifts.
words.example_zh: 拙劣的排班让三位外科医生空闲，一位连做两班。

words.en: impossible to stop or prevent
words.example: The inexorable rise in rents pushed longtime residents out within five years.
words.example_zh: 不可阻挡的租金上涨在五年内把老住户挤了出去。

words.en: innocent and unsuspecting; artlessly frank
words.example: His ingenuous question exposed an assumption that the assembled experts had never once examined.
words.example_zh: 他天真的问题暴露了在座专家从未检验过的一个假设。

words.en: existing in something as a permanent attribute
words.example: There is an inherent tension between speed and accuracy in this process.
words.example_zh: 在这一流程中，速度与准确性之间存在固有的张力。

words.en: tending to obstruct or harm; unfriendly
words.example: The new rules proved inimical to the small workshops they claimed to protect.
words.example_zh: 新规则对它们声称要保护的小作坊反而有害。

words.en: not harmful or offensive
words.example: The innocuous phrasing of clause nine hid a provision transferring all liability to tenants.
words.example_zh: 第九条看似无害的措辞掩藏了把全部责任转给租户的条款。

words.en: impossible to understand or interpret
words.example: The committee's reasoning remained inscrutable even after the full minutes were finally released.
words.example_zh: 即使完整会议记录最终公布，委员会的推理仍难以理解。

words.en: proceeding harmfully in a subtle, gradual way
words.example: Corrosion is insidious, weakening steel beams for years before any visible sign appears.
words.example_zh: 腐蚀是潜伏的，在出现任何可见迹象前已削弱钢梁多年。

words.en: lacking flavor, vigor, or interest
words.example: The insipid sequel repeated every joke without any of the original timing.
words.example_zh: 乏味的续集重复了每个笑点，却全无原作的节奏感。

words.en: showing rude and arrogant disrespect
words.example: His insolent reply to the health inspector eventually cost the restaurant its operating license.
words.example_zh: 他对卫生检查员无礼的回答最终让餐厅失去了经营许可。

words.en: narrow-minded through isolation from other cultures
words.example: The field grew insular, citing mostly itself and ignoring important work published abroad.
words.example_zh: 这个领域变得狭隘，主要引用自己，忽视国外发表的重要成果。

words.en: hard to control, manage, or solve
words.example: Traffic congestion proved intractable despite four separate rounds of investment in new roads.
words.example_zh: 尽管在新道路上进行了四轮投资，交通拥堵仍难以解决。

words.en: unwilling to change one's views or agree
words.example: Both sides remained intransigent, and the exhausted mediator withdrew after nine fruitless days.
words.example_zh: 双方都不肯妥协，疲惫的调解人在九天无果后退出。

words.en: fearless and adventurous
words.example: The intrepid surveyor mapped the canyon alone with a compass and notebook.
words.example_zh: 这位无畏的测绘员只带指南针和笔记本独自测绘了峡谷。

words.en: to overwhelm with things or flood with water
words.example: The small office was inundated with applications after a single mention on national television.
words.example_zh: 在全国电视上被提及一次后，这间小办公室就被申请书淹没了。

words.en: insulting, abusive, or highly critical language
words.example: The pamphlet's relentless invective obscured whatever legitimate complaints its author may have had.
words.example_zh: 这本小册子无休止的辱骂掩盖了作者可能有的任何正当诉求。

words.en: having a long-established and unlikely to change habit
words.example: An inveterate collector, he eventually filled two apartments with old maps and atlases.
words.example_zh: 作为成癖的收藏者，他最终用旧地图和地图册装满了两套公寓。

words.en: easily provoked to anger
words.example: The irascible chef fired three assistants in a single evening and rehired two of them.
words.example_zh: 这位暴躁的主厨一晚解雇了三名助手，又重新雇回其中两人。

words.en: traveling from place to place, especially for work
words.example: Itinerant teachers served six mountain villages that could not each support a school alone.
words.example_zh: 流动教师服务于六个无法各自单独办学的山村。

words.en: to abandon or discard something no longer wanted
words.example: The team jettisoned its original hypothesis after two months of contrary results.
words.example_zh: 团队在两个月的相反结果后抛弃了最初的假设。

words.en: fond of joking; humorous
words.example: His jocular manner disguised how carefully he had prepared every figure in the report.
words.example_zh: 他诙谐的态度掩盖了他对报告中每个数字的精心准备。

words.en: showing good judgment and sense
words.example: Judicious editing cut the film by twenty minutes and improved it considerably.
words.example_zh: 审慎的剪辑让影片缩短二十分钟并大为改善。

words.en: to place close together for contrasting effect
words.example: The exhibit juxtaposes wartime photographs with the cheerful advertisements printed beside them.
words.example_zh: 展览把战时照片与当时印在旁边的欢快广告并置。

words.en: intricate and confusing like a maze
words.example: The labyrinthine approval process discouraged all but the most determined and patient applicants.
words.example_zh: 迷宫般的审批流程劝退了除最坚定耐心者之外的所有申请人。

words.en: using very few words
words.example: His laconic reply, only two words long, ended the argument almost immediately.
words.example_zh: 他仅两个词的简短回答几乎立刻结束了争论。

words.en: to criticize someone harshly
words.example: Editorials lambasted the agency for ignoring warnings it had already received twice that year.
words.example_zh: 社论痛斥该机构无视当年已两次收到的警告。

words.en: showing little energy or effort; slow and relaxed
words.example: The languid pace of the second movement puts some listeners to sleep.
words.example_zh: 第二乐章缓慢的节奏让一些听众入睡。

words.en: generosity in giving money or gifts
words.example: The museum depended on the largesse of two families for thirty years.
words.example_zh: 这家博物馆三十年间依赖两个家族的慷慨捐助。

words.en: existing but not yet developed or visible
words.example: The virus can remain latent for several decades before any symptoms ever appear.
words.example_zh: 该病毒可潜伏数十年才出现任何症状。

words.en: to praise highly, especially publicly
words.example: The mayor lauded volunteers who had cleared the river for three weekends.
words.example_zh: 市长赞扬了连续三个周末清理河道的志愿者。

words.en: sluggish and lacking energy
words.example: The lethargic market showed no reaction to news that once moved it sharply.
words.example_zh: 疲弱的市场对曾令其剧烈波动的消息毫无反应。

words.en: humor or lack of seriousness, often inappropriate
words.example: A moment of levity relieved a hearing that had grown unbearably tense.
words.example_zh: 一刻的轻松幽默缓解了紧张到难以忍受的听证会。

words.en: tending to talk a great deal
words.example: The loquacious witness volunteered dozens of details that no attorney had actually requested.
words.example_zh: 这位健谈的证人主动提供了几十个没有律师要求的细节。

words.en: expressed clearly and easy to understand
words.example: Her lucid summary made a notoriously difficult proof accessible to first-year undergraduates.
words.example_zh: 她清晰的概述让一个出名困难的证明对一年级本科生变得易懂。

words.en: looking or sounding sad and dismal
words.example: The lugubrious music made the whole wedding feel oddly like a memorial service.
words.example_zh: 忧郁的音乐让整场婚礼诡异地像一场追悼会。

words.en: generous or forgiving, especially toward a rival
words.example: In defeat he was magnanimous, praising opponents who had attacked him relentlessly.
words.example_zh: 败选后他宽宏大量，赞扬了曾无情攻击他的对手。

words.en: wrongdoing, especially by a public official
words.example: The audit uncovered malfeasance stretching back through two municipal administrations and dozens of contracts.
words.example_zh: 审计揭露了可追溯到两届市政府、涉及数十份合同的渎职行为。

words.en: to pretend illness to avoid work or duty
words.example: Supervisors accused him of malingering, but a specialist later confirmed the back injury.
words.example_zh: 主管指责他装病，但专科医生后来证实了背部损伤。

words.en: easily shaped, whether physically or in opinion
words.example: Public opinion on the tax proved far more malleable than the strategists had assumed.
words.example_zh: 公众对税收的意见比策略师们设想的更容易被塑造。

words.zh: 多愁善感的；感情脆弱的
words.en: self-pityingly or tearfully sentimental
words.example: The final chapter turns maudlin, undermining the restraint of everything before it.
words.example_zh: 最后一章变得多愁善感，破坏了之前所有的克制。

words.zh: 独行其是者；不合常规的
words.en: an unorthodox or independent-minded person
words.example: A maverick among economists, she published mostly in journals outside her field.
words.example_zh: 作为经济学家中的独行者，她主要在本领域之外的期刊发表文章。

words.en: not telling the truth; lying
words.example: The prospectus was mendacious in almost every material respect and eventually attracted regulators.
words.example_zh: 这份招股说明书在几乎每个实质方面都虚假，最终招来了监管机构。

words.en: subject to sudden and unpredictable changes of mood
words.example: Working for so mercurial a director exhausted even his most patient longtime collaborators.
words.example_zh: 为如此善变的导演工作，连他最耐心的老合作者也疲惫不堪。

words.en: showing great attention to detail; very careful
words.example: Meticulous measurements taken over nine years revealed a slow drift that nobody expected.
words.example_zh: 九年间一丝不苟的测量揭示了一种无人预料的缓慢偏移。

words.zh: 厌恶人类者；愤世嫉俗者
words.en: a person who dislikes humankind
words.example: He played the misanthrope in public but quietly supported four local charities.
words.example_zh: 他公开扮演愤世嫉俗者，却私下资助四家本地慈善机构。

words.en: to make less severe or painful
words.example: Planting along the ridge mitigated erosion that had troubled farmers for decades.
words.example_zh: 沿山脊植树减轻了困扰农民数十年的水土流失。

words.en: to appease the anger or anxiety of someone
words.example: A partial refund and a written apology mollified most customers who had threatened to sue.
words.example_zh: 部分退款和书面道歉安抚了大多数曾威胁起诉的客户。

words.en: sullen and ill-tempered
words.example: He grew morose in the weeks after the laboratory closed and his team dispersed.
words.example_zh: 实验室关闭、团队解散后的几周里他变得阴郁。

words.en: lacking interest or excitement; ordinary
words.example: Most of the job was mundane, involving forms and phone calls rather than discovery.
words.example_zh: 这份工作大部分很平凡，涉及表格和电话而非发现。

words.en: very generous in giving
words.example: A munificent bequest allowed the orchestra to survive two unusually difficult concert seasons.
words.example_zh: 一笔慷慨的遗赠让乐团度过了两个异常艰难的演出季。

words.en: a countless or extremely great number
words.example: The reform faced a myriad of objections, most of them procedural rather than substantive.
words.example_zh: 这项改革面临无数反对意见，多数是程序性的而非实质性的。

words.en: the lowest point in a situation or fortune
words.example: The company's nadir came in the spring, when even suppliers refused credit.
words.example_zh: 公司的谷底出现在春天，当时连供应商也拒绝赊账。

words.en: just coming into existence and beginning to develop
words.example: The nascent industry employed only forty people in a converted garage outside town.
words.example_zh: 这个新兴产业当时只在城外一间改建车库里雇了四十人。

words.en: vague or ill-defined
words.example: The mission statement was nebulous enough to justify almost any project the director wanted.
words.example_zh: 这份使命宣言含糊到足以为主任想要的几乎任何项目辩护。

words.en: wicked or criminal in nature
words.example: The accounts served no nefarious purpose and reflected nothing worse than careless bookkeeping.
words.example_zh: 这些账目并无邪恶目的，反映的不过是草率的记账。

words.en: a person who is new to a subject or activity
words.example: The manual assumes a complete neophyte and patiently explains every technical term twice.
words.example_zh: 这本手册假定读者是完全的新手，耐心地把每个术语解释两遍。

words.en: so surprised or confused as to be unsure how to react
words.example: The interviewer looked nonplussed when the candidate asked to see the budget.
words.example_zh: 当候选人要求查看预算时，面试官显得不知所措。

words.zh: 臭名昭著的；声名狼藉的
words.en: famous for something bad
words.example: The intersection is notorious among local cyclists for its poor visibility and sudden turns.
words.example_zh: 这个路口因视线差和急转弯在本地骑行者中臭名昭著。

words.en: new, original, and not resembling anything former
words.example: Her novel approach to the proof avoided calculus altogether and surprised her supervisor.
words.example_zh: 她证明该定理的新颖方法完全避开微积分，让导师大感意外。

words.en: harmful, poisonous, or very unpleasant
words.example: Noxious fumes from the plant forced two nearby schools to close several hours early.
words.example_zh: 工厂排出的有毒气体迫使附近两所学校提前数小时放学。

words.en: stubbornly refusing to change one's opinion
words.example: The landlord remained obdurate despite letters from every tenant in the building.
words.example_zh: 尽管收到楼内每位租户的来信，房东仍然固执如故。

words.en: to make something unclear or hard to understand
words.example: The endless footnotes seemed designed to obfuscate the argument rather than to document it.
words.example_zh: 这些无尽的脚注似乎是为混淆论证而非为注明来源而设。

words.en: excessively eager to please or obey
words.example: His obsequious praise embarrassed the visiting scholar it was meant to flatter.
words.example_zh: 他谄媚的赞美让本想奉承的访问学者感到尴尬。

words.en: stubbornly refusing to change course or opinion
words.example: Obstinate refusal to update the software left the system vulnerable for years.
words.example_zh: 固执地拒绝更新软件使系统多年处于脆弱状态。

words.en: noisy and difficult to control
words.example: An obstreperous crowd forced the invited speaker to abandon the podium after ten minutes.
words.example_zh: 喧闹难控的人群迫使受邀演讲者十分钟后放弃了讲台。

words.en: slow to understand; lacking sharpness of intellect
words.example: He was being deliberately obtuse in order to avoid answering a very simple question.
words.example_zh: 他故意装糊涂，以避免回答一个非常简单的问题。

words.en: to remove a need or difficulty
words.example: Digital records obviated the need for a warehouse the firm had leased for decades.
words.example_zh: 电子记录使公司租用数十年的仓库变得不再必要。

words.zh: 多管闲事的；爱指使人的
words.en: asserting authority in an interfering, unwanted way
words.example: An officious clerk demanded three additional forms that the published regulations never mentioned.
words.example_zh: 一位多管闲事的职员索要了三份公开规章从未提到的额外表格。

words.en: involving heavy obligations or effort
words.example: The onerous reporting requirements consumed nearly a third of the grant's total budget.
words.example_zh: 繁重的报告要求消耗了资助金总预算的近三分之一。

words.en: not able to be seen through; hard to understand
words.example: The pricing structure was deliberately opaque, and customers almost never compared competing plans.
words.example_zh: 定价结构故意含混不透明，客户几乎从不比较相竞套餐。

words.en: harsh public criticism and resulting disgrace
words.example: The decision brought opprobrium from colleagues who had once defended him in public.
words.example_zh: 这个决定招致了曾公开为他辩护的同事们的谴责。

words.en: appearing to be true but not necessarily so
words.example: The ostensible reason for the trip was research; the real one was recruitment.
words.example_zh: 这次出行表面上的理由是研究，真实理由是招募人员。

words.en: designed to impress or attract notice
words.example: The ostentatious marble lobby contrasted sharply with the cramped offices on the upper floors.
words.example_zh: 炫耀的大理石大堂与上层狭窄的办公室形成鲜明对比。

words.en: to make less severe without removing the cause
words.example: The subsidy palliated immediate hardship without addressing why local wages had stagnated for years.
words.example_zh: 补贴缓解了眼前的困境，却未触及本地工资多年停滞的原因。

words.en: a supposed remedy for all problems
words.example: Technology is no panacea for problems that are fundamentally political rather than technical.
words.example_zh: 对根本上属于政治而非技术的问题，技术并非万灵药。

words.en: a typical example or model of something
words.example: The finding did not overturn the paradigm so much as complicate it.
words.example_zh: 这一发现并未颠覆范式，而是使其复杂化。

words.en: a person or thing regarded as a perfect example
words.example: Held up as a paragon of restraint, the design influenced a generation of engineers.
words.example_zh: 作为克制的典范，这个设计影响了一代工程师。

words.en: strongly biased in support of a party or cause
words.example: The report was too partisan to persuade anyone who did not already agree.
words.example_zh: 这份报告过于偏袒，无法说服任何原本不同意的人。

words.en: the presence of something only in small quantities
words.example: A paucity of funding kept the excavation limited to a single trench.
words.example_zh: 资金匮乏使发掘仅限于一条探沟。

words.en: excessively concerned with minor rules or details
words.example: His pedantic corrections of student pronunciation distracted from an otherwise excellent lecture series.
words.example_zh: 他对学生发音的迂腐纠正分散了一个本来精彩的系列讲座的注意力。

words.en: translucently clear, in water or in expression
words.example: The pellucid explanation required no diagrams at all and took only two minutes.
words.example_zh: 这个明晰的解释完全不需要图示，只用了两分钟。

words.en: a strong liking or habitual inclination
words.example: Her penchant for archaic vocabulary charmed some readers and lost her a good many others.
words.example_zh: 她对古语词汇的偏好吸引了一些读者，也失去了不少别的读者。

words.en: extreme poverty; destitution
words.example: The composer died in penury and was widely celebrated within a single decade.
words.example_zh: 这位作曲家在贫困中去世，十年内就广受赞誉。

words.en: deceitful and untrustworthy
words.example: The memoir portrays a perfidious ally who leaked confidential plans to two competitors.
words.example_zh: 这本回忆录描绘了一个把机密计划泄露给两个竞争者的背信盟友。

words.en: done routinely, with minimal effort or care
words.example: The inspection was perfunctory, lasting nine minutes for an entire factory and its warehouses.
words.example_zh: 这次检查敷衍潦草，整座工厂及其仓库只用了九分钟。

words.en: having a harmful effect, especially gradually
words.example: The most pernicious myths are precisely those that flatter the people who believe them.
words.example_zh: 最有害的神话恰恰是那些奉承其信奉者的神话。

words.en: having keen insight and understanding
words.example: A perspicacious reader spotted the inconsistency that three professional reviewers had somehow missed.
words.example_zh: 一位敏锐的读者发现了三位专业评审不知怎么遗漏的不一致之处。

words.en: childishly sulky or bad-tempered
words.example: His petulant refusal to attend the ceremony surprised nobody who knew him.
words.example_zh: 他任性地拒绝出席典礼，认识他的人都不感到意外。

words.en: having an unemotional and calm disposition
words.example: Her phlegmatic response to the crisis steadied a staff that had been badly frightened.
words.example_zh: 她对危机的冷静反应稳定了受到严重惊吓的员工。

words.en: brief, forceful, and full of meaning
words.example: His pithy summary of the whole dispute fit comfortably into a single short sentence.
words.example_zh: 他对整场争端言简意赅的概述轻松装进了一个短句。

words.en: to make someone less angry or hostile
words.example: An apology and a modest rebate placated most of the subscribers affected by the outage.
words.example_zh: 一份道歉和一笔适度返款安抚了大多数受断网影响的订户。

words.en: seeming reasonable or probable
words.example: The explanation is plausible but rests on an assumption no one has tested.
words.example_zh: 这个解释看似合理，却建立在无人检验过的假设上。

words.en: an excessive amount of something
words.example: A plethora of nearly identical options left buyers paralyzed rather than genuinely empowered.
words.example_zh: 一大堆几乎相同的选项让买家陷入瘫痪，而非真正获得自主。

words.en: a strong verbal or written attack on an opinion
words.example: The book is a polemic rather than a history, and it never pretends otherwise.
words.example_zh: 这本书是论战而非史著，而且从不假装是别的。

words.en: slow and heavy, or dull and labored in style
words.example: The ponderous opening chapter discourages readers long before the real argument even begins.
words.example_zh: 沉闷冗长的开篇章节在真正论证开始之前很久就让读者望而却步。

words.en: dealing with things sensibly and realistically
words.example: A pragmatic compromise saved the project that ideological purity would have killed.
words.example_zh: 一个务实的妥协挽救了本会被意识形态纯粹性扼杀的项目。

words.en: not securely held; dependent on chance
words.example: The bridge's precarious condition closed it to heavy trucks for most of the decade.
words.example_zh: 这座桥不稳的状况使其在那十年的大部分时间里禁止重型卡车通行。

words.en: to cause something to happen suddenly or too soon
words.example: The resignation precipitated a crisis the board had been avoiding for months.
words.example_zh: 这次辞职促发了董事会数月来一直回避的危机。

words.en: to prevent something from happening
words.example: The wording of clause four precludes any later claim for additional compensation.
words.example_zh: 第四条的措辞排除了日后索要额外赔偿的任何可能。

words.en: a preference or special liking for something
words.example: His predilection for extremely long sentences makes the translation unusually difficult to read aloud.
words.example_zh: 他对极长句子的偏爱使译文异常难以朗读。

words.en: to be a sign or warning of a future event
words.example: The unusual quiet over the harbor presaged a storm that arrived within the hour.
words.example_zh: 海港上空异常的平静预示着一小时内到来的暴风雨。

words.en: having knowledge of events before they occur
words.example: His prescient memo about liquidity risk went entirely unread for more than two years.
words.example_zh: 他关于流动性风险的先见备忘录两年多完全无人阅读。

words.en: to speak evasively to avoid telling the truth
words.example: Rather than answer, he prevaricated until the session ran out of time.
words.example_zh: 他没有回答，而是支吾拖延到会议时间用尽。

words.en: in its original, unspoiled condition
words.example: The upper valley remained pristine largely because no road had ever reached it.
words.example_zh: 上游谷地保持原始，主要因为从未有路通到那里。

words.en: complete honesty and strong moral principles
words.example: The auditor's personal probity was the only reason anyone still trusted the published numbers.
words.example_zh: 审计师个人的正直是人们仍然信任已公布数字的唯一原因。

words.en: spending money or resources recklessly
words.example: Prodigal spending on the entrance pavilion left almost nothing for the exhibits inside.
words.example_zh: 在入口展馆上的挥霍开支几乎没给内部展品留下任何预算。

words.en: remarkably great in size, extent, or degree
words.example: He had a prodigious memory for dates and none whatsoever for faces.
words.example_zh: 他对日期有惊人的记忆力，对面孔却毫无记性。

words.en: recklessly extravagant or wasteful
words.example: Profligate use of groundwater left the whole district dependent on two distant reservoirs.
words.example_zh: 对地下水的挥霍使用使整个区依赖两座遥远的水库。

words.en: produced or existing in large quantities
words.example: Profuse apologies from the sales team did not persuade the client to renew.
words.example_zh: 销售团队大量的道歉未能说服客户续签。

words.en: to increase rapidly in number
words.example: Unlicensed clinics proliferated in the years immediately after the licensing regulation quietly lapsed.
words.example_zh: 在许可规定悄然失效后的几年里，无证诊所激增。

words.en: an inclination to behave in a particular way
words.example: The alloy has a marked propensity to crack when temperatures fall very low.
words.example_zh: 这种合金在温度极低时有明显的开裂倾向。

words.en: giving a good chance of success; favorable
words.example: Conditions were propitious for planting, and every farm began the same week.
words.example_zh: 条件有利于播种，每家农场都在同一周开始。

words.en: commonplace and unromantic
words.example: The prosaic truth was that the ship sank because a valve was left open.
words.example_zh: 平淡的真相是这艘船沉没只因一个阀门没关。

words.en: tending to change frequently or easily; versatile
words.example: A protean performer, he moved between comedy and tragedy without visible effort.
words.example_zh: 作为多变的演员，他在喜剧和悲剧间转换毫不费力。

words.en: narrow in outlook; unsophisticated
words.example: The review dismissed the entire exhibition as provincial, badly lit, and carelessly labeled.
words.example_zh: 评论把整个展览贬为眼界狭隘、照明糟糕、标签草率。

words.en: acting with care and thought for the future
words.example: It seemed prudent to keep at least six months of operating expenses in reserve.
words.example_zh: 保留至少六个月的运营支出作为储备似乎是谨慎的。

words.en: childishly silly and immature
words.example: The televised debate degenerated into puerile name-calling within the first ten minutes.
words.example_zh: 电视辩论在头十分钟内就退化为幼稚的互相辱骂。

words.en: eager or quick to argue or fight
words.example: His pugnacious courtroom style won cases but exhausted the junior lawyers working beside him.
words.example_zh: 他好斗的庭上风格赢得了案子，却让身边的年轻律师疲惫不堪。

words.en: showing great attention to correct behavior or detail
words.example: He was punctilious about citations, tracking down every quotation to its source.
words.example_zh: 他对引注极为细致，把每处引文都追溯到原始出处。

words.en: an expert who comments publicly on a subject
words.example: Every pundit on television predicted a close race, and every one of them was wrong.
words.example_zh: 电视上每位评论家都预测选情接近，而他们每一个都错了。

words.en: a state of uncertainty over a difficult choice
words.example: The offer put her in a quandary she discussed with nobody for weeks.
words.example_zh: 这个提议让她陷入困境，数周内没与任何人商量。

words.en: complaining in a whining manner
words.example: Querulous letters arrived weekly about noise that the complaining tenant himself had created.
words.example_zh: 关于噪音的抱怨信每周到来，而噪音正是这位投诉租户自己造成的。

words.en: in a state of inactivity or dormancy
words.example: The fault line stayed quiescent for eighty years before the tremors began.
words.example_zh: 这条断层静止了八十年，之后震动开始。

words.en: idealistic and impractical in pursuit of a goal
words.example: His quixotic campaign to restore the canal attracted admiration and no funding.
words.example_zh: 他修复运河的空想计划赢得了赞赏却没有资金。

words.en: bitterness or resentfulness, especially long-standing
words.example: Decades of rancor made even a simple boundary agreement politically impossible to reach.
words.example_zh: 数十年的积怨使连一项简单的边界协议在政治上都无法达成。

words.zh: 高深的；稀薄的；小圈子的
words.en: understood by a small elite group; thin, as of air
words.example: The rarefied world of manuscript collecting has perhaps two hundred serious buyers.
words.example_zh: 手稿收藏这个小圈子或许只有两百名认真的买家。

words.en: stubbornly resistant to authority or guidance
words.example: Two recalcitrant departments refused to submit their budgets for a third consecutive year.
words.example_zh: 两个顽抗的部门连续第三年拒绝提交预算。

words.en: dealing with an obscure subject; profound
words.example: Her recondite specialty had perhaps a dozen serious practitioners anywhere in the world.
words.example_zh: 她那深奥的专业方向在全世界或许只有十几位认真的从业者。

words.zh: 散发气味的；令人想起的
words.en: strongly reminiscent or suggestive of something
words.example: The morning market was redolent of cardamom, wet stone, and freshly cut mint.
words.example_zh: 清晨的市场里弥漫着豆蔻、湿石头和新割薄荷的气味。

words.en: stubborn or unresponsive to treatment
words.example: The infection proved refractory to every antibiotic that the rural hospital had in stock.
words.example_zh: 这种感染对这家乡村医院库存的每种抗生素都无反应。

words.en: to prove a statement or theory to be wrong
words.example: A single well-designed experiment refuted a claim that textbooks had repeated for thirty years.
words.example_zh: 一个精心设计的实验驳倒了教科书重复三十年的说法。

words.en: to assign to a lower position or rank
words.example: The findings were relegated to an appendix nobody was expected to read.
words.example_zh: 这些发现被降级放入无人预期会阅读的附录。

words.en: to make a forcefully reproachful protest
words.example: She remonstrated with the committee for nearly an hour before walking out in frustration.
words.example_zh: 她与委员会力争近一小时，随后沮丧地离席。

words.en: deserving strong condemnation
words.example: Withholding the safety data was reprehensible even if it was technically legal at the time.
words.example_zh: 隐瞒安全数据即使在当时法律上勉强合规，也应受谴责。

words.en: to reprimand or criticize someone gently but firmly
words.example: The teacher reproved him quietly rather than in front of the class.
words.example_zh: 老师私下轻声责备他，而不是在全班面前。

words.zh: 否认；断绝关系；拒绝承认
words.en: to refuse to accept or be associated with
words.example: The society formally repudiated the study and removed it from its own website.
words.example_zh: 该学会正式否弃了这项研究，并将其从自己的网站移除。

words.en: to revoke, cancel, or repeal a law or agreement
words.example: The board rescinded the entire policy barely three weeks after adopting it unanimously.
words.example_zh: 董事会在一致通过该政策仅三周后就将其全部撤销。

words.en: unwilling to speak freely about one's thoughts
words.example: Normally reticent, he spoke at length once the recorders had been switched off.
words.example_zh: 他平时沉默寡言，录音设备关掉后却讲了很久。

words.en: feeling or showing deep respect
words.example: The documentary is so reverent that it never raises an obvious question.
words.example_zh: 这部纪录片过于恭敬，以至于从不提出一个显而易见的问题。

words.zh: 基本的；初步的；不完全发育的
words.en: involving basic principles; undeveloped
words.example: Their equipment was rudimentary, yet the measurements they produced held up remarkably well.
words.example_zh: 他们的设备很简陋，但所得的测量结果却相当可靠。

words.en: to think deeply about something
words.example: He ruminated on the offer for a month and then declined it.
words.example_zh: 他对这个提议沉思了一个月，然后拒绝了。

words.en: having keen judgment and practical wisdom
words.example: The sagacious old editor predicted the magazine's collapse nearly two years in advance.
words.example_zh: 这位睿智的老编辑提前近两年预言了杂志的倒闭。

words.en: most noticeable or important
words.example: The salient point, buried on page forty, plainly deserved the opening paragraph instead.
words.example_zh: 最重要的一点埋在第四十页，明显本该放在开篇。

words.en: to give official approval, or to impose a penalty
words.example: The regulator sanctioned the merger only after two overlapping divisions had been sold off.
words.example_zh: 监管机构在两个业务重叠的部门被出售后才批准了这项合并。

words.en: optimistic, especially in a difficult situation
words.example: She remained sanguine about the harvest despite two full weeks without any rain.
words.example_zh: 尽管整两周没有降雨，她对收成仍保持乐观。

words.en: grimly mocking or cynical
words.example: His sardonic aside about the budget was the only honest moment of the meeting.
words.example_zh: 他关于预算的讥讽旁白是整场会议唯一诚实的时刻。

words.en: very careful, thorough, and morally correct
words.example: Scrupulous documentation of every step allowed later scholars to verify each of her claims.
words.example_zh: 对每一步的严谨记录使后来的学者能核实她的每条论断。

words.en: the occurrence of fortunate discoveries by chance
words.example: Pure serendipity led her to the missing letters inside a badly misfiled storage box.
words.example_zh: 纯粹的机缘巧合让她在一个严重错放的储物箱里找到了失踪信件。

words.en: excessively willing to serve or obey
words.example: The press became servile, printing official announcements as though they were independent reporting.
words.example_zh: 媒体变得奴性十足，把官方公告当作独立报道刊登。

words.en: showing attentive care or concern
words.example: The solicitous innkeeper checked on his elderly guests three separate times before midnight.
words.example_zh: 关切的旅店主人在午夜前三次查看年长客人的情况。

words.en: tending to induce drowsiness or sleep
words.example: The soporific afternoon lecture emptied half the hall well before the scheduled interval.
words.example_zh: 催人入睡的午后讲座在预定中场休息前就空了半个礼堂。

words.zh: 似是而非的；华而不实的
words.en: seeming plausible but actually wrong
words.example: The specious reasoning survived for years because nobody bothered to check the underlying figures.
words.example_zh: 这个似是而非的推理留存多年，因为无人费心核对底层数据。

words.en: occurring at irregular intervals
words.example: Sporadic outages continued for several months without any discernible pattern or official explanation.
words.example_zh: 零星的断电持续数月，看不出任何规律，也没有官方解释。

words.en: not genuine or based on false reasoning
words.example: The correlation was spurious, produced entirely by how the years were grouped.
words.example_zh: 这种相关性是虚假的，完全由年份的分组方式造成。

words.en: to waste money, time, or opportunity recklessly
words.example: They squandered a decade of accumulated goodwill in a single badly worded announcement.
words.example_zh: 他们用一份措辞糟糕的公告挥霍掉了十年积累的善意。

words.en: sedate, respectable, and unadventurous
words.example: The staid old firm surprised everyone by hiring a designer from a nightclub.
words.example_zh: 这家古板的老公司竟从夜店挖来一名设计师，让所有人惊讶。

words.en: lacking movement, change, or development
words.example: Wages in the region stayed static while housing costs rose by nearly half.
words.example_zh: 该地区工资停滞不动，而住房成本上涨了近一半。

words.en: to specify a requirement in an agreement
words.example: The will stipulated that the entire collection remain in the city permanently.
words.example_zh: 遗嘱规定整批收藏须永久留在该市。

words.en: enduring pain or hardship without showing feelings
words.example: Stoic through three difficult surgeries, he complained only about the hospital food.
words.example_zh: 他在三次艰难手术中都很坚忍，只抱怨过医院的食物。

words.en: loud and harsh; forcefully insistent
words.example: Her strident criticism alienated several allies who actually agreed with most of her conclusions.
words.example_zh: 她尖锐激烈的批评疏远了几位其实认同她大部分结论的盟友。

words.en: to bring under domination or control
words.example: The empire subjugated the valley quickly but never governed it effectively for long.
words.example_zh: 帝国迅速征服了这片谷地，却从未长期有效治理它。

words.en: of such excellence as to inspire awe
words.example: The final movement is sublime, and the orchestra played it without a score.
words.example_zh: 最后一个乐章崇高卓绝，乐团不看谱就演奏了它。

words.en: to provide evidence to support a claim
words.example: He could not substantiate the allegation, and the inquiry closed after only six weeks.
words.example_zh: 他无法证实这项指控，调查仅六周后就结束了。

words.en: behaving as though one is superior to others
words.example: A supercilious tone in the rejection letter offended even the most sympathetic readers.
words.example_zh: 拒信中傲慢的语气连最同情的读者也觉得刺耳。

words.en: unnecessary because more than enough exists
words.example: Two of the four safety checks were superfluous and slowed every shift.
words.example_zh: 四项安全检查中有两项多余，拖慢了每个班次。

words.en: to take the place of, especially by force or scheming
words.example: Cheap imported textiles supplanted local production almost entirely within a single decade.
words.example_zh: 廉价进口纺织品在十年内几乎完全取代了本地生产。

words.en: an excessive amount of something
words.example: A surfeit of technical detail made the report unusable for busy municipal officials.
words.example_zh: 过量的技术细节使这份报告对繁忙的市政官员毫无用处。

words.en: done secretly to avoid being noticed
words.example: Surreptitious recordings made in the warehouse later became the trial's central piece of evidence.
words.example_zh: 在仓库偷录的录音后来成为审判的核心证据。

words.en: a person who flatters someone powerful for advantage
words.example: Surrounded by sycophants, he heard no warning until the loss was public.
words.example_zh: 被谄媚者包围，他直到亏损公开才听到警告。

words.en: saying little; habitually silent
words.example: The taciturn foreman communicated mostly through hand gestures and very short written notes.
words.example_zh: 沉默寡言的工头主要通过手势和极短的书面便条交流。

words.en: only slightly relevant to the matter at hand
words.example: Most of the discussion was tangential to the decision actually facing them.
words.example_zh: 大部分讨论与他们实际面临的决定无甚关联。

words.en: equivalent in effect or value to something else
words.example: Silence from the board at that stage was tantamount to full and formal approval.
words.example_zh: 董事会在那个阶段的沉默等同于完全且正式的批准。

words.en: excessive confidence or boldness; audacity
