words.example: She had the temerity to question the chairman's figures in open session.
words.example_zh: 她竟敢在公开会议上质疑主席的数字。

words.en: showing moderation and self-restraint
words.example: His temperate response lowered the temperature of a dispute that had turned dangerous.
words.example_zh: 他温和的回应降低了一场已变得危险的争端的温度。

words.en: able to be defended against objection
words.example: After the third clear contradiction the theory was no longer tenable at all.
words.example_zh: 在第三处明显矛盾出现后，该理论已完全站不住脚。

words.en: holding firmly to something; persistent
words.example: Tenacious reporting over four long years finally forced the sealed records into public view.
words.example_zh: 四年顽强的报道最终迫使封存的记录公之于众。

words.en: very weak or slight; insubstantial
words.example: The connection between the two events is tenuous at best and possibly imaginary.
words.example_zh: 这两个事件之间的联系充其量牵强，也可能纯属虚构。

words.en: showing little enthusiasm; lukewarm
words.example: Tepid reviews doomed a stage production that had cost more than two million.
words.example_zh: 反应冷淡的评论毁掉了一部耗资超过两百万的舞台作品。

words.en: sparing in words; abrupt
words.example: His terse email answered the question in six words and ended the correspondence.
words.example_zh: 他简短的邮件用六个词回答了问题，也结束了通信。

words.en: a large crowd, or to gather in large numbers
words.example: A throng filled the square several hours before the announcement was even scheduled.
words.example_zh: 在公告预定宣布数小时前，人群已挤满广场。

words.en: showing or suffering from nervousness and fear
words.example: Timorous investors sold near the bottom and bought back far too late.
words.example_zh: 胆怯的投资者在接近底部时卖出，又太晚买回。

words.en: mentally or physically inactive; sluggish
words.example: The torpid afternoon heat emptied the market streets until nearly six in the evening.
words.example_zh: 令人倦怠的午后暑气使集市街道空无一人，直到傍晚近六点。

words.en: full of twists and turns; excessively complex
words.example: The tortuous negotiation eventually produced a document that nobody involved could summarize.
words.example_zh: 曲折复杂的谈判最终产生了一份参与者都无法概括的文件。

words.en: easy to control, manage, or solve
words.example: Reframing the question made a previously hopeless problem suddenly tractable and even interesting.
words.example_zh: 重构问题使一个先前无望的难题突然变得可解，甚至有趣。

words.en: lasting only a short time
words.example: The improvement was transient, and the original symptoms returned within a single week.
words.example_zh: 改善是短暂的，原有症状在一周内复发。

words.en: vigorous, incisive, and effective in expression
words.example: Her trenchant analysis of the budget circulated widely among staff in every department.
words.example_zh: 她对预算一针见血的分析在各部门员工中广为流传。

words.en: a feeling of fear or nervousness about what may happen
words.example: He opened the results with obvious trepidation and then laughed aloud with relief.
words.example_zh: 他带着明显的不安打开结果，随后如释重负地大笑。

words.en: overused and lacking originality or freshness
words.example: The advice sounded trite but happened to be exactly right in her situation.
words.example_zh: 这个建议听来老套，却恰好在她的处境中完全正确。

words.en: eager to argue or fight; aggressively defiant
words.example: His truculent behavior at hearings cost him the sympathy of the panel.
words.example_zh: 他在听证会上好斗的举止让他失去了专家组的同情。

words.en: swollen, or pompous and tedious in style
words.example: The turgid preface discouraged many readers who would have enjoyed the chapters that followed.
words.example_zh: 浮夸的序言劝退了许多本会喜欢后面章节的读者。

words.en: present or found everywhere
words.example: Plastic microfibers are now ubiquitous, appearing even in snow sampled from remote mountains.
words.example_zh: 塑料微纤维如今无处不在，甚至出现在偏远山区采样的积雪中。

words.en: offense or annoyance at a perceived slight
words.example: He took umbrage at a remark the speaker had not intended personally.
words.example_zh: 他对演讲者并非针对个人的一句话感到不快。

words.en: leaving no doubt; unambiguous
words.example: The written instructions were unequivocal, yet two separate crews still managed to misread them.
words.example_zh: 书面指示明确无误，但仍有两个班组把它们读错了。

words.zh: 站不住脚的；难以维持的
words.en: not able to be defended or maintained
words.example: His position became completely untenable once the internal emails were published in full.
words.example_zh: 内部邮件被全文公布后，他的立场变得彻底难以维持。

words.en: unexpected and inconvenient or unseemly
words.example: Nothing untoward appeared in the accounts until the final quarter of that year.
words.example_zh: 直到那年最后一个季度，账目上才出现不妥之处。

words.en: to seize power or a position wrongfully
words.example: Committees gradually usurped authority that the charter had clearly given to the faculty.
words.example_zh: 各委员会逐步篡夺了章程明确赋予教师的权力。

words.en: to waver between different opinions or actions
words.example: The board vacillated for six months while its competitors moved quickly and decisively.
words.example_zh: 董事会犹豫了六个月，而竞争对手迅速果断地行动。

words.en: offering nothing stimulating or challenging
words.example: The vapid interview questions produced polite answers that absolutely nobody remembered afterward.
words.example_zh: 乏味的采访问题得到了礼貌的回答，事后完全无人记得。

words.en: to regard with great respect or reverence
words.example: Students venerated a teacher who had failed most of them at least once.
words.example_zh: 学生们崇敬这位至少让他们大多数人挂科一次的老师。

words.en: conformity to facts; truthfulness
words.example: Nobody questioned the veracity of the diary until the paper was tested.
words.example_zh: 在纸张被检测之前，无人质疑这本日记的真实性。

words.en: using more words than necessary
words.example: A verbose opening chapter hides what is genuinely an original and important argument.
words.example_zh: 冗长的开篇章节掩藏了一个真正原创而重要的论点。

words.en: to make someone annoyed or worried
words.example: The unexplained discrepancy vexed the accountants through three consecutive annual audits and two reviews.
words.example_zh: 这处无法解释的差异让会计师在连续三次年度审计和两次复核中都为之困扰。

words.en: capable of working successfully or surviving
words.example: Only one of the four proposals turned out to be financially viable.
words.example_zh: 四项提案中最终只有一项在财务上可行。

words.en: experienced through another person rather than directly
words.example: She took vicarious pleasure in the fieldwork her students carried out abroad each summer.
words.example_zh: 她从学生们每个夏天在海外开展的田野工作中获得间接的快乐。

words.en: a change of circumstances, typically unwelcome
words.example: The family endured the vicissitudes of three currency collapses and two long wars.
words.example_zh: 这个家庭经受了三次货币崩溃和两场长期战争的变迁。

words.en: to speak or write about in an abusively disparaging way
words.example: The press vilified her for a decision the entire committee had approved.
words.example_zh: 媒体因一项整个委员会都批准的决定而对她大加诽谤。

words.en: to clear of blame or prove correct
words.example: Later measurements vindicated a hypothesis that the field had dismissed for twenty years.
words.example_zh: 后来的测量证明了该领域否定二十年的一个假说是正确的。

words.en: having a strong desire for revenge
words.example: The lawsuit looked less strategic than simply vindictive, and the judge said so.
words.example_zh: 这场诉讼看起来不像出于策略，而只是报复，法官也这么说。

words.en: to regard with disgust and hatred
words.example: She abhorred the practice but continued to work within the system that allowed it.
words.example_zh: 她憎恶这种做法，却继续在容许它的体制内工作。

words.en: to choose not to do or consume something
words.example: Two members abstained from the vote, and the motion passed by a single ballot.
words.example_zh: 两名成员在表决中弃权，动议以一票之差通过。

words.en: enthusiastic public praise
words.example: The novel won critical acclaim and sold fewer than a thousand copies.
words.example_zh: 这部小说赢得了评论界的赞誉，却卖出不到一千册。

words.en: a natural liking or close relationship
words.example: He had an affinity for languages and picked up three during the survey.
words.example_zh: 他对语言有天然的亲和力，在这次调查中学会了三门。

words.en: showing selfless concern for the welfare of others
words.example: The donation looked entirely altruistic until the family's tax filings became public last year.
words.example_zh: 在这家人的纳税申报去年公开之前，这笔捐赠看来完全无私。

words.en: to pacify by acceding to demands
words.example: Concessions meant to appease the union satisfied nobody on either side of the table.
words.example_zh: 意在安抚工会的让步让谈判桌两边都不满意。

words.en: anxious that something bad will happen
words.example: Farmers were apprehensive about a forecast that promised rain and delivered none.
words.example_zh: 农民对承诺有雨却毫无落实的预报感到忧虑。

words.en: based on random choice rather than reason
words.example: The cutoff at forty pages was arbitrary and excluded three strong entries.
words.example_zh: 四十页的截止标准是武断的，排除了三份优秀作品。

words.en: very old or old-fashioned; no longer in use
words.example: The statute uses archaic terms that courts must now translate case by case.
words.example_zh: 该法规使用古旧术语，法院如今须逐案解释。

words.en: to find something out with certainty
words.example: Investigators could not ascertain who had actually authorized the transfer of those funds.
words.example_zh: 调查人员无法查明究竟是谁批准了那笔资金的转移。

words.en: to prevent something bad, or to turn away
words.example: A last-minute loan averted a default that would have closed the port.
words.example_zh: 一笔最后时刻的贷款避免了本会导致港口关闭的违约。

words.en: gentle and kindly; not harmful
words.example: The growth proved benign, though the wait for results lasted eleven days.
words.example_zh: 肿块被证明是良性的，尽管等结果等了十一天。

words.en: bold and without shame
words.example: The brazen forgery was signed with the artist's own name spelled incorrectly.
words.example_zh: 这份肆无忌惮的伪作签的是艺术家本人的名字，却拼错了。

words.en: to support or reinforce an argument or structure
words.example: Three new excavation studies buttressed a conclusion once widely considered purely speculative.
words.example_zh: 三项新的发掘研究支持了一个曾被广泛视为纯属推测的结论。

words.en: to persuade someone by force or threats
words.example: Nobody was formally coerced, but every employee understood what a refusal would cost.
words.example_zh: 没有人被正式胁迫，但每位员工都明白拒绝的代价。

words.en: to admit something is true or to yield
words.example: He conceded the point in private but refused to change a single published sentence.
words.example_zh: 他私下承认了这一点，却拒绝改动已发表的任何一句话。

words.en: an opinion formed without complete evidence
words.example: Everything beyond the first paragraph is conjecture carefully dressed up as documented history.
words.example_zh: 第一段之后的一切都是精心伪装成有据史实的推测。

words.en: obviously planned or artificial; forced
words.example: The reunion scene felt contrived, as though the plot itself had demanded it.
words.example_zh: 重逢的场景显得牵强，好像情节本身强行需要它。

words.en: to come together from different directions
words.example: Estimates from four entirely independent methods converged on the same century and region.
words.example_zh: 四种完全独立的方法的估算汇聚到同一个世纪和地区。

words.en: to reduce or restrict something
words.example: Budget cuts curtailed fieldwork just as the first promising results began to arrive.
words.example_zh: 预算削减恰在首批有希望的结果开始出现时缩减了田野工作。

words.en: distrustful of others' motives or sincerity
words.example: Voters grew cynical after three consecutive promises about the hospital went entirely unfunded.
words.example_zh: 在关于医院的三项连续承诺完全没有资金落实后，选民变得愤世嫉俗。

words.en: to make someone feel intimidated or discouraged
words.example: The scale of the archive daunted every graduate student who saw it.
words.example_zh: 档案的规模让每个见到它的研究生望而生畏。

words.en: to publicly denounce as harmful or wrong
words.example: Economists decried the new tariff while politicians from both parties enthusiastically praised it.
words.example_zh: 经济学家谴责这项新关税，而两党政治人物都热情赞扬它。

words.en: quick and neatly skillful
words.example: A deft revision of only two paragraphs saved the entire chapter from rejection.
words.example_zh: 仅对两段文字娴熟的修改就使整章免于被否。

words.en: to use up the supply or resources of
words.example: Two consecutive dry summers depleted reserves that would normally have lasted three years.
words.example_zh: 连续两个干旱夏季耗尽了通常够用三年的储备。

words.zh: 业余爱好者；浅尝辄止者
words.en: a person with superficial interest in a subject
words.example: Dismissed as a dilettante, he published the field's standard reference at fifty.
words.example_zh: 他曾被贬为浅尝辄止者，五十岁时却出版了该领域的标准参考书。

words.en: to make a feeling or belief disappear
words.example: One clear photograph dispelled rumors that had circulated in the village for years.
words.example_zh: 一张清晰的照片消除了在村里流传多年的谣言。

words.en: to make known private or sensitive information
words.example: She refused to divulge her sources even under the threat of a contempt charge.
words.example_zh: 即使面临藐视法庭指控的威胁，她也拒绝透露消息来源。

words.en: ready to accept control or instruction
words.example: The normally docile herd panicked at the sound of the low-flying helicopter.
words.example_zh: 平时温顺的畜群在低飞直升机的声音中惊慌起来。

words.en: deceitfulness; contradictory double-dealing
words.example: The letters revealed a duplicity that ended two long friendships almost at once.
words.example_zh: 这些信件揭露了一种几乎同时终结两段长久友谊的两面派行为。

words.en: to escape from or fail to be grasped by
words.example: The pattern eluded analysts until somebody finally plotted the raw data by hour.
words.example_zh: 在有人终于按小时绘制原始数据之前，这个规律一直让分析师无从察觉。

words.en: not even or regular in pattern or movement
words.example: Erratic funding from year to year made any serious long-term planning effectively impossible.
words.example_zh: 逐年不稳定的资金使任何严肃的长期规划实际上无法进行。

words.en: based on or containing error; wrong
words.example: The erroneous figure was reprinted in four separate textbooks before anyone publicly objected.
words.example_zh: 这个错误数字被四本不同的教科书转载后才有人公开提出异议。

words.en: to strongly encourage someone to do something
words.example: The coach exhorted his players to stop watching the scoreboard and keep passing.
words.example_zh: 教练力劝球员不要再盯着记分牌，继续传球。

words.en: filled with lively energy and excitement
words.example: The exuberant crowd stayed in the square long after the results were final.
words.example_zh: 热情洋溢的人群在结果尘埃落定后仍久留广场。

words.en: to pretend to feel or have something
words.example: He feigned surprise at figures he had personally reviewed only the previous week.
words.example_zh: 他对自己前一周才亲自审阅过的数字假装吃惊。

words.en: changing frequently in loyalty or affection
words.example: The fickle market abandoned the format entirely within about eighteen short months.
words.example_zh: 变化无常的市场在约十八个月内就完全抛弃了这一格式。

words.en: inspiring fear or respect through size or ability
words.example: She was a formidable opponent in debate and a generous colleague afterward.
words.example_zh: 她在辩论中是令人敬畏的对手，会后又是宽厚的同事。

words.en: incapable of producing any useful result
words.example: Further appeals were futile once the filing deadline had quietly passed in March.
words.example_zh: 一旦申报期限在三月悄然过去，进一步的申诉就是徒劳。

words.en: to shock or excite someone into action
words.example: A single photograph galvanized a public that had ignored years of detailed reports.
words.example_zh: 一张照片激起了多年来忽视详细报道的公众。

words.en: to provoke someone into action or reaction
words.example: Hecklers in the front row goaded him into a response he immediately regretted.
words.example_zh: 前排的捣乱者激得他做出立刻后悔的回应。

words.en: easily persuaded to believe something
words.example: The scheme targeted gullible buyers with verbal promises that no contract ever contained.
words.example_zh: 这个骗局用合同中从未包含的口头承诺针对轻信的买家。

words.en: to hinder or impede movement or progress
words.example: Dense fog hampered the search for three days and then lifted quite suddenly.
words.example_zh: 浓雾妨碍搜救三天，随后相当突然地消散。

words.en: of the same kind; uniform throughout
words.example: The sample was too homogeneous to support conclusions about the wider population.
words.example_zh: 样本过于同质，无法支持关于更广泛人群的结论。

words.en: excessive pride or self-confidence
words.example: It was hubris, not bad luck, that sent the expedition up in October.
words.example_zh: 让这支探险队在十月出发的是狂妄，而非坏运气。

words.en: to delay or block the progress of
words.example: Accumulated silt impeded the channel until dredging finally resumed in the early spring.
words.example_zh: 积聚的淤泥阻塞航道，直到早春疏浚终于重新开始。

words.en: acting quickly without thought or care
words.example: One impetuous email from him undid six months of careful and patient negotiation.
words.example_zh: 他一封冲动的邮件毁掉了六个月谨慎耐心的谈判。

words.en: inborn rather than learned
words.example: Whether the preference is innate or learned in childhood remains genuinely unsettled today.
words.example_zh: 这种偏好是天生还是童年习得，如今确实仍无定论。

words.en: to arouse an emotion, or to start a fire
words.example: A single lecture kindled an interest that lasted the rest of his life.
words.example_zh: 一场讲座点燃了他终生不灭的兴趣。

words.en: praise and honor for an achievement
words.example: Kudos went to the director, though the editor had rescued the film.
words.example_zh: 赞誉归于导演，尽管是剪辑师救了这部片子。

words.en: to decrease in strength, size, or importance
words.example: Public interest waned quickly once the trial moved on to technical expert testimony.
words.example_zh: 当审判转入技术专家证词后，公众兴趣迅速减弱。

words.en: deliberate and unprovoked in causing harm
words.example: The report described wanton destruction of records for which no plausible justification existed.
words.example_zh: 报告描述了对档案的肆意销毁，对此不存在任何合理理由。

words.en: cautious about possible dangers or problems
words.example: Editors grew wary of him after two of his articles were formally retracted.
words.example_zh: 在他两篇文章被正式撤回后，编辑们对他变得警惕。

words.zh: 异想天开的；古怪有趣的
words.en: playfully unusual or unpredictable
words.example: The whimsical illustrations soften a text that is otherwise quite grim and unforgiving.
words.example_zh: 异想天开的插图缓和了本来相当阴郁无情的文字。

words.en: skilled at gaining an advantage by deception
words.example: A wily negotiator, he conceded loudly on points that he had never wanted anyway.
words.example_zh: 作为狡猾的谈判者，他在本来就不想要的条款上大声让步。

words.en: having a feeling of vague or regretful longing
words.example: She grew wistful while describing a laboratory building that no longer exists anywhere.
words.example_zh: 描述一座早已不存在的实验楼时，她变得怅然。

words.en: dislike of or prejudice against foreigners
words.example: Economic anxiety and xenophobia are closely related but far from identical phenomena.
words.example_zh: 经济焦虑与仇外情绪密切相关，但远非同一现象。

words.en: to give way, or to produce a result or crop
words.example: The soil yields little without irrigation, and the wells run dry by August.
words.example_zh: 没有灌溉这片土壤产量很低，而水井在八月就干涸。

words.en: a person who is fanatical about a cause
words.example: Reformers were dismissed as zealots until their central proposals quietly became national law.
words.example_zh: 改革者被贬为狂热分子，直到他们的核心提案悄然成为国家法律。

words.en: the highest point reached by something
words.example: The company reached its zenith two years before anyone noticed the decline.
words.example_zh: 这家公司在无人察觉衰退的两年前就已达到顶点。
